fields.title: Yesu Yennyini
fields.description: “Yesu Yennyini” kwe kwekkaanya okumulisa okw'obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo nga kuyita mu Njiri ya Lukka. Ekitabo kino kiraga enkyukakyuka y'abayigirizwa, okuva mu kubuusabuusa okutuuka ku kukkiriza okutanyeenyezebwa, nga kiggumiza obwetaavu bw'okuwangula obutakkiriza okufuna omukwano ogw'amaanyi ne Yesu. Nga kijjudde amagezi ag'omwoyo, kikulembera abasomi eri omukwano ogumatiza n'Omulokozi waabwe, nga kifuula Yesu munne ow'emirembe n'emirembe.

fields.title: Amaaso gaabwe ne gazibuka ne bamutegeera.
fields.body_html:
Ebigambo bye njagala okukozesa okuwa obubaka obwangu bisangibwa mu Njiri ya Lukka 24:31: "Amaaso gaabwe ne gazibuka ne bamutegeera."

Olumu nabuulira okubuulira nga nkozesa ebigambo "Yesu Yennyini" ng'omusingi; era bwe nnali nzirayo eka ne ŋŋamba abaali batambula nange nti: "Kisoboka kitya okuba ne Yesu Yennyini naffe nga tetumanyi; era kisoboka kitya okubuulira amazima gonna agakwata ku Yesu Yennyini, n'okugawuliriza, naye ne tutamumanya Yye." Sisobola kugamba nga kye nalowooza kyankwata kitya ku mutima.

Kale, abayigirizwa bano baali bamaze ekiseera kya mukisa nnyo ne Yesu; naye singa baali bagenze ng'akyaliko okweraga akawungeezi kali, tebandifunye bukakafu nti yali Yesu, kubanga amaaso gaabwe gaali gazibiddwa baleme kumutegeera. Eyo, eky'ennaku, y'embeera y'ekibiina ekinene mu Kkanisa ya Kristo. Bamanyi nti Kristo yazuukira mu bafu. Bakkiriza, era emirundi mingi bafuna ebyokulabirako ebya mukisa ebiva eri Kristo omuzuukufu.

Emirundi mingi, mu biseera by'enkuŋŋaana ennene, oba mu kiseera ky'okusoma Bayibuli mu kasirise, oba mu kiseera Katonda mw'akyalira abantu be n'ekisa kye, emitima gyabwe gyaka; naye era kiyinza okwogerwa ku bantu abalina emitima egyaka munda yaabwe, nti tebaamanya nti yali Yesu Yennyini. Kale nno, bw'ombuuza omukisa omukulu gwe tusaana okunoonya, eky'okuddamu kyange kye kino: si kulowooza kwokka ku Yesu Yennyini, n'okwogera ku Yye, n'okumukkiriza, naye tusaana okutuuka awo abayigirizwa ab'omu kyawandiikibwa we baatuuka: "ne bamutegeera." Byonna bisangibwa omwo.

Bwe nsoma olugero lwa bayigirizwa abaali batambula okugenda Emawu, ndabamu amadaala ana ag'obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo. Mulowooze! Baatandika batya enkya y'olunaku luli? Nga balina emitima egijjudde ennaku n'okweraliikirira, kubanga baalowooza nti Yesu afudde. Tebaamanya nti mulamu, era eyo y'embeera ya Bakristaayo bangi nnyo. Batunuulira omusaalaba, bafuba okwesiga Kristo, naye tebannayiga mukisa gwa kukkiriza nti waliwo Kristo omulamu ow'okubakolera byonna. Woowe! Ekigambo kiri ekya malayika eri abakazi! "Lwaki omuntu omulamu mumunoonyeza mu ntaana?" Lukka 24:5. Njawulo ki eriwo wakati wa Kristo omufu, abakazi gwe baali bagenda okusiiga amafuta, ne Kristo omulamu? Kristo omufu, nze nsaana okumukolera byonna; Kristo omulamu ye ankolera byonna nze.

Abayigirizwa baatandika enkya nga balina emitima egijjudde ennaku. Ndowooza baasula tebeebase. Woowe!

Okusuulibwa okw'entiisa! Baali basuubidde nti Kristo y'anaanunula Isiraeri, ate baamulaba ng'afa okufa okw'ekikolimo. Ku nkya y'olunaku olwo olusooka mu wiiki, baagolokoka nga balina emitima eminakuwavu; obuyinike buli tebwogerekeka. Bwe butyo bwe buli obulamu bwa Bakristaayo bangi.

Bafuba okukkiriza Yesu, okumwesiga n'okumusuubira, naye tewali ssanyu. Lwaki? Kubanga tebamanyi nti waliwo Kristo omulamu eyeetegese okweraga.

Awo ne wajja eddaala eryokubiri. Lye liruwa? Ddaala Kristo mw'ayogerera nti: "ab'emitima eminafu egirwawo okukkiriza" Lukka 24:25-26. Baali bafunye obubaka bw'abakazi. Baategeeza omugenyi eyali atambula nabo nti: "Abakazi abamu ab'ewaffe baatwewuunyisa. Bwe baakomyewo baatugambye nti bayolesebbwa ba bamalayika abaabagambye nti mulamu." Lukka 24:23. Kristo n'abaddamu nti: "Nga muli bantu basirusiru, ab'emitima eminafu egirwawo okukkiriza!" Lukka 24:25-26.

Waliwo Bakristaayo bangi leero abaawulira era abamanyi nti tebasaana kukkiriza Kristo eyakomererwa yekka, naye ne Kristo omulamu, era bafuba okukikwata n'okukitegeera, naye tekibaleetera mukisa. Lwaki? Kubanga baagala kukiwulira mu mubiri so si kukikkiriza. Baagala okukikolera, okukifuna lwa maanyi gaabwe, mu kifo ky'okuteeka obuteeka emitima gyabwe mu Yye n'okukkiriza nti: "Kristo, Yesu omulamu, ajja kutukolera byonna." Eryo lye ddaala eryokubiri. Eddaala erisooka lye ry'obutamanya; eryokubiri lye ry'obutakkiriza: omutima ogubuusabuusa ogutasobola kukkiriza mazima ag'ekitalo nti Yesu mulamu.

Awo ne lijja eddaala eryokusatu: omutima ogwaka. Yesu yajja eri abayigirizwa ababiri, era bwe yamala okubanenya ng'agamba nti, "Nga muli bantu basirusiru, ab'emitima eminafu egirwawo okukkiriza," n'atandika okubabikkulira Ebyawandiikibwa, n'okubategeeza ebintu byonna eby'ekitalo bannabbi bye baayigiriza. Awo amaaso gaabwe ne gatandika okuzibuka, ne batandika okutegeera Ebyawandiikibwa. Ne balaba nga kya mazima nti kyalagulwa nti Kristo asaana okuzuukira. Bwe yali ng'ayogera, mu Yye — Omuzuukufu omulamu — ne muva amaanyi amangi ne gabakkako, ne batandika okuwulira emitima gyabwe nga gyaka munda yaabwe olw'essanyu n'okujaguza.

Oyinza okugamba nti: "Eryo lye ddaala lye twagala okutuukako." Nedda; Katonda akuziyize okoma awo. Oyinza okutuuka ku ddaala eryo eryokusatu, omutima ogwaka, naye ekintu kimu nga kikyabulayo: okubikkulirwa kwa Kristo. Abayigirizwa baali bafunye okulaba amaanyi ge ag'obwakatonda, naye yali tanneyeraga yennyini. Era woowe! Emirundi emeka mu nkuŋŋaana ne mu makanisa, mu kusinza ne mu kussekimu okwa mukisa n'abatukuvu ba Katonda, emitima gyaffe gyaka munda yaffe.

Ebyo bye byokulabirako eby'omuwendo eby'omulimu gw'ekisa kya Katonda n'ogw'Omwoyo we, naye era ekintu kimu kibulayo. Kiki ekyo? Yesu Yennyini abadde akolera mu ffe, n'amaanyi g'obulamu bwe obw'okuzuukira gatukutteko, naye tetusobola kugamba nti: "Nsisinkanye Yye. Yeeraze gye ndi." Woowe, enjawulo eriwo wakati w'omutima ogwaka, oguwola oluvannyuma lw'ekiseera, ogujja ne gugenda, n'okubikkulirwa okwa mukisa okwa Yesu Yennyini ng'Omulokozi wange, antwala mu mikono gye, ampa omukisa era ankuuma buli lunaku!

Lino ly'eddaala ly'omutima ogumativu. Owange muganda wange, mwannyinaze! Kye nkusabira, era nkakasa nti naawe kye weesabira. Nange nkyesabira. Mukama Yesu! Tukumanye mu kitiibwa kyo eky'obwakatonda ng'Omuzuukufu, Yesu waffe, Omwagalwa waffe, Ow'amaanyi waffe. Woowe! Bwe wabaawo alina ennaku atasobola kukkiriza kino, n'agamba nti, "Sinnamanya ssanyu lya kukkiriza," wuliriza: tujja kukubuulira engeri gy'oyinza okulimanya. Byonna binaasinziira mu kintu kino ekimu: nga omwana omuto bw'abeera buli lunaku mu mikono gya nnyina, n'akulira mu maaso ga nnyina omwaka gumu oluvannyuma lw'omulala, bwe kityo kisoboka ggwe okubeera buli lunaku na buli ssaawa ey'obulamu bwo mu kussekimu ne Yesu omutukuvu. Yye ajja kukikukolera.

Jjangu, n'omutima gwo ogunakuwavu gutandike okusuubira. Anaayeraga? Yakikola eri abayigirizwa, era ajja kukikola naawe. Oboolyawo abamu bavudde ku mutima ogunakuwavu naye era bakyawulira nti: "Sinnafuna kye njagala." Bw'oggulawo omutima gwo gwonna n'oleka byonna, n'okkiriza bukkiriza n'omuganya akole ky'ayagala, kijja kujja. Katonda atenderezebwe! Kijja kujja. Yesu ajja kweraga!

Oboolyawo otuuse ku ddaala ly'omutima ogwaka, era osobola okwogera ku byakulabirako bingi ebya mukisa, naye mu ngeri emu waliwo envunyu ku kikolo. Ebyokulabirako tebisigalawo, n'omutima gukyukakyuka nnyo. Woowe, jjangu, omwagalwa wange! Goberera Kristo. Gamba nti: "Yesu, weerage tukumanye. Tetusaba kunywa mazzi amalamu gokka; twagala n'ensulo yennyini. Tetusaba kunaaba mu kitangaala kyokka; twagala Enjuba ey'Obutuukirivu munda mu mitima gyaffe.

Tetusaba kukumanya gwe wekka, ggwe eyatukutteko, n'obuguumya emitima gyaffe n'otuwa omukisa; twagala okumanya nti tulina Yesu atakyuka ng'abeera mu mitima gyaffe era ng'asigala naffe emirembe gyonna."

Kaakano wajja ekibuuzo kye nnali njagala okubuuza: "Biki ebisaanyizo Mukama waffe ow'omukisa by'ayeragiramu?" Oba tukyogere bwe tuti: Yesu anaayeraga eri ani?

Kitwetaagisa kulaba bulabi engeri gye yayisaamu abayigirizwa bano, ne tufuna eky'okuddamu. Kiki eky'okuddamu? Okusooka, ndowooza nsanga wano nti Kristo yeeraga eri abayigirizwa abaali baleseeyo byonna ku lulwe.

Yali abagambye nti: "Omuntu bw'ayagala okungoberera asaana yeefiirize yekka, yeetikke omusaalaba gwe alyoke angoberere," Matayo 16:24, era ne bakikola. Wamu n'obunafu bwabwe bwonna n'obutali bwesigwa bwabwe, baagoberera Kristo okutuusa ku nkomerero. Yabagamba nti: "Naye mmwe mubadde wamu nange mu biseera bino eby'okugezesebwa kwange, era kubanga Kitange ampadde obwakabaka, noolwekyo mbaatulira kati nti mbawadde ekifo" Lukka 22:28-29. Tebaali bantu batuukirivu, naye bandifiiridde Yye. Baamwagala, baamugondera, era baamugoberera. Baali baleseeyo byonna, era okumala emyaka esatu baali bagoberera Kristo n'obunyiikivu. Ogamba nti: "Mbuulira Kristo ky'anjagalako, bwe nnaabeera n'okubeerawo kwe okw'ekitalo. Mbuulira empisa z'omuntu Kristo gw'anaayeragira mu ngeri eno esingira ddala obukulu n'okujjula." Nziramu nti: "Ye oyo eyeetegese okuleka byonna n'okumugoberera."

Kristo bw'anaampa yennyini yenna, asaana amanye nti annina nzekka ku lulwe; era nnessiga Katonda okuwa ekisa, ebigambo bino ebyogerwa ku kwewaayo n'okwerekereza — si kuleka bibi byokka, naye n'ebintu bingi ebikkirizibwa, era, bwe kibeetaagisa, n'obulamu bwennyini — bitutuuse okutegeera Yesu ky'atusaba. Ekigambo ekikulu ekya Cape General Mission kye kino: "Katonda asooke."

Mu ngeri emu ekyo kigambo kirungi, naye era tekinsanyusa bulijjo, kubanga kigambo ekitegeerwa bubi emirundi mingi. "Katonda asooke" kiyinza okutegeeza "nze" nga nsooka mu byange, ekintu ekirala nga kye kyokusatu, n'ekirala nga kye kyokuna. Bw'atyo Katonda aba asoose mu lunyiriri, naye era Katonda afuuka omu ku maanyi mangi agaddiriŋŋana, ate ekyo si kye kifo Katonda ky'ayagala. Amakulu g'ebigambo "Katonda asooke" ddala ge gano: "Katonda byonna; Katonda buli kintu"; era ekyo Kristo ky'ayagala. Okuba omwetegefu okuleka byonna, okwewaayo eri Kristo akuyigirize eky'okwogera n'eky'okukola: ako ke kabonero akasooka ak'omuntu Kristo gw'anajjira. Toli mwetegefu kutambula ddaala lino n'ogamba nti: "Yesu! Ndese byonna; nnaleka byonna; weerage gye ndi"? Owange muganda wange! Owange mwannyinaze! Tolonzalonza. Kyogere mu mutima gwo, era ekiseera kino kibeere kye kiseera ssaddaaka empya mw'eteekebwa ku bigere by'Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda ow'omukisa.

Waliwo ekirowoozo ekyokubiri. Okusooka waliwo ekya kuba nga waleseeyo byonna okumugoberera; okuba nga wagaba byonna mu kumugondera, n'obeera mu bulamu obwangu obw'okwagala n'okugondera. Naye waliwo ekintu ekyokubiri ekyetaagisa mu muntu anaafuna okubikkulirwa kuno okujjuvu okwa Kristo. Asaana akakasibwe obutakkiriza bwe.

"Nga muli bantu basirusiru, ab'emitima eminafu egirwawo okukkiriza bannabbi bye baategeeza!" Lukka 24:25. Owange muganda wange, mwannyinaze, singa twandisobodde okulaba obungi bw'obutakkiriza obuli mu mitima gy'abaana ba Katonda, nga businga oluggi ne buggalira Kristo ebweru w'omutima, twandiyimiridde nga twewuunya era nga tukwatibwa ensonyi!

Awatali butakkiriza, naye awali okukkiriza, Kristo tayinza butayingira. Tayinza butajja awali okukkiriza okulamu, okukkiriza okujjuvu. Omutima guggule, omutima gutegeke, era ng'amazzi bwe gakulukutira mu kifo ekyetoloovu awatali kubuusabuusa, bw'atyo Kristo bw'ateekwa okuyingira mu mutima ogujjudde okukkiriza.

Kiki ekiziyiza emmeeme ezimu ezinyiikivu ezigamba nti: "Neewaayo eri Mukama Yesu. Nkikoze emirundi mingi, era olw'ekisa kye nkikola buli lunaku, ne Katonda amanyi nga bwe nkikola n'omutima gwonna, era nnina obujulizi bwa Katonda ku ekyo; mmanyi Katonda ampadde omukisa"?

Tebannakakasibwa butakkiriza bwabwe. "Nga muli bantu basirusiru, ab'emitima eminafu egirwawo okukkiriza!" Omanyi Kristo kye yayogera ku muntu ayita muganda we omusirusiru? Naye wano Omwana wa Katonda ow'okwagala teyafuna kigambo kirala kya kugamba bayigirizwa be abaagalwa wabula nti: "Nga muli bantu basirusiru, ab'emitima eminafu egirwawo okukkiriza!" Oyagala Mukama Yesu akuwe okubikkulirwa kuno okujjuvu okwa yennyini? Oli mwetegefu okukkiriza nti obadde musirusiru olw'obutamukkirizanga? "Mukama Yesu, nsobezza nze.

Oli awo, ng'oyaayaanira okunnina. Obadde awo n'ebisuubizo byo eby'obwesigwa, ng'olindirira okweraga." Wali owulidde ku muntu ayagala munne naye nga tayaayaanira kweraga gy'ali?

Kristo ayaayaanira okweraga, naye tasobola olw'obutakkiriza bwaffe. Katonda atukakase obutakkiriza bwaffe, tukwatibwe ensonyi ddala era tumenyeke, tukaabe nti: "Ayi Katonda wange, kiki kino, omutima guno ogw'obutakkiriza oguteeka ekiziyiza mu luggi Kristo aleme kuyingira, oguzibikira amaaso gange nneme kulaba Yesu, ate nga ali kumpi bw'ati? Abadde wano emyaka kkumi oba abiri, ng'ampa buli kiseera omutima ogwaka, nga ndega ku katono ak'okwagala kwe n'ekisa kye, naye era sinnafuna kubikkulirwa kwa Yye, okunnina omutima gwange n'okubeera nange awatali kusalako." Woowe! Katonda atukakase obutakkiriza. Tukkirize, kubanga byonna bisoboka eri oyo akkiriza. Ekyo kigambo kya Katonda, era omukisa guno, okufuna okubikkulirwa kwa Yesu, gujja eri abo bokka abayiga okukkiriza n'okumwesiga.

Waliwo akabonero akalala ak'abo okubikkulirwa kuno okw'enjawulo okwa Kristo kwe kunajjira, ke kano: tebawummula okutuusa lwe bakufuna.

Mumanyi olugero. Emitima gyabwe gyali gyaka bwe baali basemberera ekifo gye baali bagenda, Kristo n'akola ng'agenda mu maaso. Yabagezesa; era singa baamuleka n'agenda mirembe, singa baamatira n'okulaba omutima ogwaka kwokka, bandifiiriddwa ekintu ekisinga obulungi obutagerekeka. Naye tebaamatira nakwo. Tebaamatira kuddayo eka ekiro ekyo eri abayigirizwa n'okugamba nti: "Woowe, olweggulo lwa mukisa lwe tubadde nalwo! Okuyigirizibwa okw'ekitalo kwe tufunye!" Nedda! Omutima ogwaka n'okulaba okwa mukisa byabaleetera okugamba nti: "Sula naffe," ne bamuwaliriza okuyingira. Baamuwaliriza okuyingira.

Bulijjo kinzijukiza olugero lwa Yakobo: "Sijja kukuta nga tompadde mukisa." Olubereberye 32:26. Ogwo gwe mwoyo ogututegekera okubikkulirwa kwa Yesu. Owange mukwano gwange omwagalwa! Guno gwe gubadde omwoyo gwe tutunuuliddemu omukisa ogw'ekitalo gwe tumaze okuwulirako? "Ayi Mukama wange Yesu, newaakubadde sitegeera, newaakubadde sisobola kukikwata, n'okufuba kwange tekugasa, sijja kukuta ogende.

Oba omwonoonyi ku nsi asobola okuba ne Yesu buli lunaku, buli ssaawa na buli kaseera, ng'abeera mu mutima gwe mu maanyi ag'okuzuukira, ng'ayakaayakana munda ye, ng'amujjuza okwagala n'essanyu; oba ekyo kisoboka, nkyagala." Ebyo bye bigambo byo? Woowe! Jjangu nno ogambe nti: "Mukama Yesu, sijja kukuta nga tompadde mukisa." Ekibuuzo kibuuzibwa emirundi mingi nnyo nti: "Nsonga ki eleetera obulamu bwa Bakristaayo bangi bwe buti okunafuwa?" Kiki ekituse? Kiki kye babulwa?

Ng'Ekkanisa yaawulira katono okuyita kwa Kristo! Ng'Ekkanisa eri wala n'ekyo Kristo ky'andyagadde ebeere! Nsonga ki evudde ku mitawaana gyonna? Ebyokuddamu bingi biyinza okuweebwa, naye waliwo eky'okuddamu kimu ekigatta ebirala byonna, kye kino: buli mukkiriza abulwa okubikkulirwa okujjuvu okwa yekka okwa Kristo ow'oyekka nga Mukama abeera munda ye, ng'omugabo ogumumaliriza. Mukama Yesu bwe yali wano ku nsi, kiki ekyayawulanga abayigirizwa be n'abantu abalala? Yabaggya ku butimba bwabwe obw'okuvuba ne mu maka gaabwe, n'abakuŋŋaanyiza okumwetooloola, era baamanya Yesu. Ye yali Mukama waabwe ng'abakuuma, nabo nga bamugoberera.

Era kiki ekinaayawulanga abayigirizwa ba Kristo — si abo abasuubira busuubizi okutuuka mu ggulu, naye abayigirizwa ba Kristo ab'omutima gwonna — n'abantu abalala? Kye kino: okubeera mu kussekimu ne Yesu buli ssaawa ey'olunaku. Era nga Kristo ku nsi bwe yasobola okukuuma abantu bali naye emyaka esatu, olunaku ku lunaku, bw'atyo Kristo kaakano asobola okukola okuva mu ggulu ekyo kye yali tasobola kukola ng'ali ku nsi: okukuuma okussekimu okusingira ddala okumpi ne buli mukkiriza mu nsi yonna. Ekitiibwa kibe eri Katonda!

Mumanyi ekyawandiikibwa kiri ekya Abaefeso: "Oyo Kristo eyakka, ye wuuyo ddala eyalinnya ewala ennyo, n'ayisa waggulu w'eggulu lyonna, alyoke ajjule obwengula bw'ensi yonna." Abaefeso 4:10. Lwaki Mukama wange Yesu yatwalibwa mu ggulu okuva mu bulamu bw'ensi? Kubanga obulamu bw'ensi bulamu obusibiddwa mu bifo, naye obulamu obw'omu ggulu bulamu obutaliiko kkomo wala nsalo wala kifo; era Kristo yatwalibwa mu ggulu, mu maanyi ga Katonda, Katonda abeera wonna, alyoke asobole okujjuza buli muntu wano n'okubeera ne buli mukkiriza. Ekyo omutima gwange kye gwagala okufuna olw'okukkiriza; ekyo kisoboka, ekyo kisuubizo, ogwo gwe mugabo gwange ogw'obuzaale, era njagala okuba nagwo, era njagala olw'ekisa kya Katonda okugamba nti: "Yesu, sijja kuwummula okutuusa lw'oneeyanjulira ddala emmeeme yange."

Emirundi mingi waliwo ebyokulabirako ebya mukisa nnyo mu bulamu obw'Ekikristaayo mu ddaala lye mpita eryokusatu: eddaala ly'omutima ogwaka. Mumanyi akabonero akalala akakulu ak'eddaala eryo? Okusanyukira Ekigambo kya Katonda. Abayigirizwa baafuna batya omutima ogwaka? Olw'okubikkulirwa Ebyawandiikibwa mu ngeri eri ey'ekitalo. Yafuula byonna okulabika nga bya njawulo era nga bipya, ne balaba bye baali batalabangako. Tebaayinza butawulira nga okuyigiriza kuli bwe kwali okw'ekitalo, okw'omu ggulu.

Woowe! Waliwo Bakristaayo bangi ekiseera ekisinga obulungi eky'olunaku gye bali kye kiseera we basobolera okutuula ne Bayibuli zaabwe, era tewali kye baagala ng'okufuna ekirowoozo ekipya; era ng'omusimi wa almasi bw'asanyuka ng'azudde almasi, oba omusimi wa zaabu ng'azudde ekitole kya zaabu, bwe batyo basanyuka bwe baggya mu Bayibuli ekirowoozo ekipya, ne bakiriira. Naye wamu n'obwo obwagazi bwonna mu Kigambo kya Katonda, n'okwo okusanyuka kwonna okw'omutima, bwe bagenda mu byobusuubuzi byabwe oba ne bakola emirimu gyabwe egya buli lunaku, ekintu kimu kikyabulayo.

Tusaana tuve mu mikisa emingi egya buli ngeri Yesu gy'asobola okugaba buli kiseera, tutuuke ku bumu obwa mukisa obw'eguno ogumu: nti Yesu yeeyanjula yennyini. Yesu Yennyini mwetegefu okweyanjula. Woowe! Singa mbuuzizza nti: "Kino si kye kintu ddala ggwe nange kye twagala, era abangi ku ffe kye tubadde twegomba?" nkakasa nti mwandizzeemu nti: "Ekyo kye njagala."

Mulowooze ku mukisa oguliva mu ekyo. Emirundi mingi muyimba nti: "Woowe, emirembe Omulokozi wange gy'ampa! Emirembe gye nnali simanyangako, n'ekkubo lyange lyeyongedde okwaka kasookedde njiga okumwesiga ennyo." Juuzi nafuna ebbaluwa okuva eri omuntu ow'e Free State ng'egamba akatundu kali ak'oluyimba nga bwe kaali essuubi n'amaanyi ag'ekitalo wakati mu bizibu n'ennaku. Weewaawo; naye emirembe egyo gikuumibwa gitya? Kwali kubeerawo kwa Kristo okwaleeta emirembe. Omuyaga bwe gwali gugenda okumira abayigirizwa, kwali kubeerawo kwa Kristo Yennyini okwabawa emirembe.

Owange Omukristaayo! Oyagala emirembe n'okuwummula? Oteekwa okuba ne Yesu Yennyini. Oyogera ku bulongoofu, oyogera ku kutukuzibwa n'okununulibwa okuva mu kibi. Katonda atenderezebwe: okununulibwa n'okutukuzibwa kuli wano, Yesu omulamu bw'ajja n'awa amaanyi. Awo tuba ne Kristo ono ow'okuzuukira, Kristo ono ow'omu ggulu ali ku ntebe ey'obwakabaka, nga yeeyanjula gye tuli. Mazima ddala ekyo kye kinaabeera ekyama ky'obulongoofu era ekyama ky'amaanyi.

Amaanyi g'abangi gava wa? Mu ssanyu ery'omukwano ogwa yekka ne Yesu. Abayigirizwa bali, singa baddayo n'emitima gyabwe egyaka eri abayigirizwa abalala, bandibategeezza ebintu eby'ekitalo ku musajja eyabannyonnyola Ebyawandiikibwa n'ebisuubizo, naye tebandisobodde kugamba nti: "Tulabye Yesu." Bandiyinzizza okugamba nti: "Yesu mulamu; ekyo tulina obukakafu," naye ekyo tekyandimatizza balala. Naye kaakano baali basobola okugenda n'okugamba nti: "Tumulabye Yye Yennyini. Yeeyanjudde gye tuli." Ffenna tusanyuka okukolera Kristo, naye waliwo okwemulugunya mu Kkanisa yonna eya Kristo, okuva ku basumba mu mimbala okutuuka ku mukozi asingira ddala obunafu: obutaba na ssanyu n'obutaba na mukisa.

Tugezeeko okunoonyereza oba nga wano si we wali ekyama: nti Mukama Yesu ajje yeeyanjule gye tuli nga Mukama waffe ayogere naffe. Bwe tuba ne Yesu naffe, era bwe tutambula buli kigere nga tulowooza nti Yesu y'ayagala tugende, nti Yesu y'atutuma era y'atuyamba, awo wanaabeerawo okwakaayakana mu bujulizi bwaffe, era bunaayamba abakkiriza abalala, nabo banaatandika okutegeera nti: "Kaakano ndabye ensonga lwaki nnalemererwa. Nnatwala ekigambo, nnatwala omukisa, ne ntwala, nga bwe nnalowooza, obulamu, naye nnali sirina Yesu omulamu."

Bw'obuuza kaakano nti: "Okubikkulirwa kuno kunajja kutya?" Muganda wange, mwannyinaze: ekyo kye kyama omuntu yenna ky'atayinza kwogera, Yesu ky'yeekuumira yekka. Mu maanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu Kristo, Omuzuukufu, mwe yayingirira obulamu obupya. Obulamu bwe obw'okuzuukira bwa njawulo ddala n'obulamu bwe obwaliwo ng'akyali kufa. Mumanyi kye tusoma nti: "ne bamutegeera." Lukka 24:31. Yeeraga, oluvannyuma n'abulawo. Era okulaba kuli okwa Kristo kwali kwa muwendo bwe gutyo? Kwabula mu kaseera katono. Kwali kwa muwendo gwa ggulu, gwa milembe na milembe, gwa buli kintu. Lwaki? Kubanga okuva olwo Kristo teyali wa kumanyibwa nate mu ngeri ya mubiri. Okuva olwo Kristo yali mu maanyi g'Omwoyo, agajjuza eggulu; mu maanyi g'Omwoyo, ge maanyi g'Obwakatonda; mu maanyi g'Omwoyo, agajjuza emitima gyaffe. Okuva olwo Kristo yali wa kubeera mu bulamu obw'omu ggulu.

Katonda yeebazibwe, Kristo asobola, mu maanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, okweraga eri buli omu ku ffe; naye, muganda wange, kigambo kya kyama wakati wa Kristo naawe. Twala obukakafu buno: "Amaaso gaabwe ne gazibuka ne bamutegeera," era okkirize nti bwawandiikirwa ggwe. Ogamba nti: "Mmanyi amadaala amalala asatu: eddaala ly'omutima ogunakuwavu, nga nkungubaga nti saamanya Kristo omulamu; mmanyi eddaala ly'omutima omunafu okukkiriza, bwe nnalwana n'obutakkiriza bwange; era mmanyi eddaala ly'omutima ogwaka, awali ebiseera ebikulu eby'essanyu n'omukisa."

Ogamba bw'otyo? Jjangu nno omanye eddaala eryokuna: ery'omutima ogumativu, omutima ogusanyusibbwa emirembe gyonna, omutima ogutasobola kuziyiza ssanyu lyagwo, naye oguddayo e Yerusaalemi ne gugamba nti: "Kya mazima. Yesu yeeraze. Nkimanyi, nkiwulira." Owange muganda wange! Owange mwannyinaze! Okubikkulirwa kuno kunajja kutya? Yesu ajja kukubuulira. Jjangu eri Mukama Yesu, ossekimu mu maaso ge okusaba okwangu okw'ekyana, nange, omuweereza we, nnajja ne nkukwata ku mukono ne ŋŋamba nti: "Jjangu; omulimu gwange guwedde. Ndaze Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda, Omuzuukufu. Omulimu gwange guwedde."

Tuyingire mu Maaso Amatukuvu, otandike — oba tonnakunoonya — otandike okwegayirira nti: "Ayi Omulokozi! Mbeere n'omukisa guno buli kaseera wamu nange: Yesu Yennyini, omugabo gwange emirembe gyonna."

"Yesu Yennyini." "Ndi nammwe bulijjo."
fields.body_text: Ebigambo bye njagala okukozesa okuwa obubaka obwangu bisangibwa mu Njiri ya Lukka 24:31: "Amaaso gaabwe ne gazibuka ne bamutegeera." Olumu nabuulira okubuulira nga nkozesa ebigambo "Yesu Yennyini" ng'omusingi; era bwe nnali nzirayo eka ne ŋŋamba abaali batambula nange nti: "Kisoboka kitya okuba ne Yesu Yennyini naffe nga tetumanyi; era kisoboka kitya okubuulira amazima gonna agakwata ku Yesu Yennyini, n'okugawuliriza, naye ne tutamumanya Yye." Sisobola kugamba nga kye nalowooza kyankwata kitya ku mutima. Kale, abayigirizwa bano baali bamaze ekiseera kya mukisa nnyo ne Yesu; naye singa baali bagenze ng'akyaliko okweraga akawungeezi kali, tebandifunye bukakafu nti yali Yesu, kubanga amaaso gaabwe gaali gazibiddwa baleme kumutegeera. Eyo, eky'ennaku, y'embeera y'ekibiina ekinene mu Kkanisa ya Kristo. Bamanyi nti Kristo yazuukira mu bafu. Bakkiriza, era emirundi mingi bafuna ebyokulabirako ebya mukisa ebiva eri Kristo omuzuukufu. Emirundi mingi, mu biseera by'enkuŋŋaana ennene, oba mu kiseera ky'okusoma Bayibuli mu kasirise, oba mu kiseera Katonda mw'akyalira abantu be n'ekisa kye, emitima gyabwe gyaka; naye era kiyinza okwogerwa ku bantu abalina emitima egyaka munda yaabwe, nti tebaamanya nti yali Yesu Yennyini. Kale nno, bw'ombuuza omukisa omukulu gwe tusaana okunoonya, eky'okuddamu kyange kye kino: si kulowooza kwokka ku Yesu Yennyini, n'okwogera ku Yye, n'okumukkiriza, naye tusaana okutuuka awo abayigirizwa ab'omu kyawandiikibwa we baatuuka: "ne bamutegeera." Byonna bisangibwa omwo. Bwe nsoma olugero lwa bayigirizwa abaali batambula okugenda Emawu, ndabamu amadaala ana ag'obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo. Mulowooze! Baatandika batya enkya y'olunaku luli? Nga balina emitima egijjudde ennaku n'okweraliikirira, kubanga baalowooza nti Yesu afudde. Tebaamanya nti mulamu, era eyo y'embeera ya Bakristaayo bangi nnyo. Batunuulira omusaalaba, bafuba okwesiga Kristo, naye tebannayiga mukisa gwa kukkiriza nti waliwo Kristo omulamu ow'okubakolera byonna. Woowe! Ekigambo kiri ekya malayika eri abakazi! "Lwaki omuntu omulamu mumunoonyeza mu ntaana?" Lukka 24:5. Njawulo ki eriwo wakati wa Kristo omufu, abakazi gwe baali bagenda okusiiga amafuta, ne Kristo omulamu? Kristo omufu, nze nsaana okumukolera byonna; Kristo omulamu ye ankolera byonna nze. Abayigirizwa baatandika enkya nga balina emitima egijjudde ennaku. Ndowooza baasula tebeebase. Woowe! Okusuulibwa okw'entiisa! Baali basuubidde nti Kristo y'anaanunula Isiraeri, ate baamulaba ng'afa okufa okw'ekikolimo. Ku nkya y'olunaku olwo olusooka mu wiiki, baagolokoka nga balina emitima eminakuwavu; obuyinike buli tebwogerekeka. Bwe butyo bwe buli obulamu bwa Bakristaayo bangi. Bafuba okukkiriza Yesu, okumwesiga n'okumusuubira, naye tewali ssanyu. Lwaki? Kubanga tebamanyi nti waliwo Kristo omulamu eyeetegese okweraga. Awo ne wajja eddaala eryokubiri. Lye liruwa? Ddaala Kristo mw'ayogerera nti: "ab'emitima eminafu egirwawo okukkiriza" Lukka 24:25-26. Baali bafunye obubaka bw'abakazi. Baategeeza omugenyi eyali atambula nabo nti: "Abakazi abamu ab'ewaffe baatwewuunyisa. Bwe baakomyewo baatugambye nti bayolesebbwa ba bamalayika abaabagambye nti mulamu." Lukka 24:23. Kristo n'abaddamu nti: "Nga muli bantu basirusiru, ab'emitima eminafu egirwawo okukkiriza!" Lukka 24:25-26. Waliwo Bakristaayo bangi leero abaawulira era abamanyi nti tebasaana kukkiriza Kristo eyakomererwa yekka, naye ne Kristo omulamu, era bafuba okukikwata n'okukitegeera, naye tekibaleetera mukisa. Lwaki? Kubanga baagala kukiwulira mu mubiri so si kukikkiriza. Baagala okukikolera, okukifuna lwa maanyi gaabwe, mu kifo ky'okuteeka obuteeka emitima gyabwe mu Yye n'okukkiriza nti: "Kristo, Yesu omulamu, ajja kutukolera byonna." Eryo lye ddaala eryokubiri. Eddaala erisooka lye ry'obutamanya; eryokubiri lye ry'obutakkiriza: omutima ogubuusabuusa ogutasobola kukkiriza mazima ag'ekitalo nti Yesu mulamu. Awo ne lijja eddaala eryokusatu: omutima ogwaka. Yesu yajja eri abayigirizwa ababiri, era bwe yamala okubanenya ng'agamba nti, "Nga muli bantu basirusiru, ab'emitima eminafu egirwawo okukkiriza," n'atandika okubabikkulira Ebyawandiikibwa, n'okubategeeza ebintu byonna eby'ekitalo bannabbi bye baayigiriza. Awo amaaso gaabwe ne gatandika okuzibuka, ne batandika okutegeera Ebyawandiikibwa. Ne balaba nga kya mazima nti kyalagulwa nti Kristo asaana okuzuukira. Bwe yali ng'ayogera, mu Yye — Omuzuukufu omulamu — ne muva amaanyi amangi ne gabakkako, ne batandika okuwulira emitima gyabwe nga gyaka munda yaabwe olw'essanyu n'okujaguza. Oyinza okugamba nti: "Eryo lye ddaala lye twagala okutuukako." Nedda; Katonda akuziyize okoma awo. Oyinza okutuuka ku ddaala eryo eryokusatu, omutima ogwaka, naye ekintu kimu nga kikyabulayo: okubikkulirwa kwa Kristo. Abayigirizwa baali bafunye okulaba amaanyi ge ag'obwakatonda, naye yali tanneyeraga yennyini. Era woowe! Emirundi emeka mu nkuŋŋaana ne mu makanisa, mu kusinza ne mu kussekimu okwa mukisa n'abatukuvu ba Katonda, emitima gyaffe gyaka munda yaffe. Ebyo bye byokulabirako eby'omuwendo eby'omulimu gw'ekisa kya Katonda n'ogw'Omwoyo we, naye era ekintu kimu kibulayo. Kiki ekyo? Yesu Yennyini abadde akolera mu ffe, n'amaanyi g'obulamu bwe obw'okuzuukira gatukutteko, naye tetusobola kugamba nti: "Nsisinkanye Yye. Yeeraze gye ndi." Woowe, enjawulo eriwo wakati w'omutima ogwaka, oguwola oluvannyuma lw'ekiseera, ogujja ne gugenda, n'okubikkulirwa okwa mukisa okwa Yesu Yennyini ng'Omulokozi wange, antwala mu mikono gye, ampa omukisa era ankuuma buli lunaku! Lino ly'eddaala ly'omutima ogumativu. Owange muganda wange, mwannyinaze! Kye nkusabira, era nkakasa nti naawe kye weesabira. Nange nkyesabira. Mukama Yesu! Tukumanye mu kitiibwa kyo eky'obwakatonda ng'Omuzuukufu, Yesu waffe, Omwagalwa waffe, Ow'amaanyi waffe. Woowe! Bwe wabaawo alina ennaku atasobola kukkiriza kino, n'agamba nti, "Sinnamanya ssanyu lya kukkiriza," wuliriza: tujja kukubuulira engeri gy'oyinza okulimanya. Byonna binaasinziira mu kintu kino ekimu: nga omwana omuto bw'abeera buli lunaku mu mikono gya nnyina, n'akulira mu maaso ga nnyina omwaka gumu oluvannyuma lw'omulala, bwe kityo kisoboka ggwe okubeera buli lunaku na buli ssaawa ey'obulamu bwo mu kussekimu ne Yesu omutukuvu. Yye ajja kukikukolera. Jjangu, n'omutima gwo ogunakuwavu gutandike okusuubira. Anaayeraga? Yakikola eri abayigirizwa, era ajja kukikola naawe. Oboolyawo abamu bavudde ku mutima ogunakuwavu naye era bakyawulira nti: "Sinnafuna kye njagala." Bw'oggulawo omutima gwo gwonna n'oleka byonna, n'okkiriza bukkiriza n'omuganya akole ky'ayagala, kijja kujja. Katonda atenderezebwe! Kijja kujja. Yesu ajja kweraga! Oboolyawo otuuse ku ddaala ly'omutima ogwaka, era osobola okwogera ku byakulabirako bingi ebya mukisa, naye mu ngeri emu waliwo envunyu ku kikolo. Ebyokulabirako tebisigalawo, n'omutima gukyukakyuka nnyo. Woowe, jjangu, omwagalwa wange! Goberera Kristo. Gamba nti: "Yesu, weerage tukumanye. Tetusaba kunywa mazzi amalamu gokka; twagala n'ensulo yennyini. Tetusaba kunaaba mu kitangaala kyokka; twagala Enjuba ey'Obutuukirivu munda mu mitima gyaffe. Tetusaba kukumanya gwe wekka, ggwe eyatukutteko, n'obuguumya emitima gyaffe n'otuwa omukisa; twagala okumanya nti tulina Yesu atakyuka ng'abeera mu mitima gyaffe era ng'asigala naffe emirembe gyonna." Kaakano wajja ekibuuzo kye nnali njagala okubuuza: "Biki ebisaanyizo Mukama waffe ow'omukisa by'ayeragiramu?" Oba tukyogere bwe tuti: Yesu anaayeraga eri ani? Kitwetaagisa kulaba bulabi engeri gye yayisaamu abayigirizwa bano, ne tufuna eky'okuddamu. Kiki eky'okuddamu? Okusooka, ndowooza nsanga wano nti Kristo yeeraga eri abayigirizwa abaali baleseeyo byonna ku lulwe. Yali abagambye nti: "Omuntu bw'ayagala okungoberera asaana yeefiirize yekka, yeetikke omusaalaba gwe alyoke angoberere," Matayo 16:24, era ne bakikola. Wamu n'obunafu bwabwe bwonna n'obutali bwesigwa bwabwe, baagoberera Kristo okutuusa ku nkomerero. Yabagamba nti: "Naye mmwe mubadde wamu nange mu biseera bino eby'okugezesebwa kwange, era kubanga Kitange ampadde obwakabaka, noolwekyo mbaatulira kati nti mbawadde ekifo" Lukka 22:28-29. Tebaali bantu batuukirivu, naye bandifiiridde Yye. Baamwagala, baamugondera, era baamugoberera. Baali baleseeyo byonna, era okumala emyaka esatu baali bagoberera Kristo n'obunyiikivu. Ogamba nti: "Mbuulira Kristo ky'anjagalako, bwe nnaabeera n'okubeerawo kwe okw'ekitalo. Mbuulira empisa z'omuntu Kristo gw'anaayeragira mu ngeri eno esingira ddala obukulu n'okujjula." Nziramu nti: "Ye oyo eyeetegese okuleka byonna n'okumugoberera." Kristo bw'anaampa yennyini yenna, asaana amanye nti annina nzekka ku lulwe; era nnessiga Katonda okuwa ekisa, ebigambo bino ebyogerwa ku kwewaayo n'okwerekereza — si kuleka bibi byokka, naye n'ebintu bingi ebikkirizibwa, era, bwe kibeetaagisa, n'obulamu bwennyini — bitutuuse okutegeera Yesu ky'atusaba. Ekigambo ekikulu ekya Cape General Mission kye kino: "Katonda asooke." Mu ngeri emu ekyo kigambo kirungi, naye era tekinsanyusa bulijjo, kubanga kigambo ekitegeerwa bubi emirundi mingi. "Katonda asooke" kiyinza okutegeeza "nze" nga nsooka mu byange, ekintu ekirala nga kye kyokusatu, n'ekirala nga kye kyokuna. Bw'atyo Katonda aba asoose mu lunyiriri, naye era Katonda afuuka omu ku maanyi mangi agaddiriŋŋana, ate ekyo si kye kifo Katonda ky'ayagala. Amakulu g'ebigambo "Katonda asooke" ddala ge gano: "Katonda byonna; Katonda buli kintu"; era ekyo Kristo ky'ayagala. Okuba omwetegefu okuleka byonna, okwewaayo eri Kristo akuyigirize eky'okwogera n'eky'okukola: ako ke kabonero akasooka ak'omuntu Kristo gw'anajjira. Toli mwetegefu kutambula ddaala lino n'ogamba nti: "Yesu! Ndese byonna; nnaleka byonna; weerage gye ndi"? Owange muganda wange! Owange mwannyinaze! Tolonzalonza. Kyogere mu mutima gwo, era ekiseera kino kibeere kye kiseera ssaddaaka empya mw'eteekebwa ku bigere by'Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda ow'omukisa. Waliwo ekirowoozo ekyokubiri. Okusooka waliwo ekya kuba nga waleseeyo byonna okumugoberera; okuba nga wagaba byonna mu kumugondera, n'obeera mu bulamu obwangu obw'okwagala n'okugondera. Naye waliwo ekintu ekyokubiri ekyetaagisa mu muntu anaafuna okubikkulirwa kuno okujjuvu okwa Kristo. Asaana akakasibwe obutakkiriza bwe. "Nga muli bantu basirusiru, ab'emitima eminafu egirwawo okukkiriza bannabbi bye baategeeza!" Lukka 24:25. Owange muganda wange, mwannyinaze, singa twandisobodde okulaba obungi bw'obutakkiriza obuli mu mitima gy'abaana ba Katonda, nga businga oluggi ne buggalira Kristo ebweru w'omutima, twandiyimiridde nga twewuunya era nga tukwatibwa ensonyi! Awatali butakkiriza, naye awali okukkiriza, Kristo tayinza butayingira. Tayinza butajja awali okukkiriza okulamu, okukkiriza okujjuvu. Omutima guggule, omutima gutegeke, era ng'amazzi bwe gakulukutira mu kifo ekyetoloovu awatali kubuusabuusa, bw'atyo Kristo bw'ateekwa okuyingira mu mutima ogujjudde okukkiriza. Kiki ekiziyiza emmeeme ezimu ezinyiikivu ezigamba nti: "Neewaayo eri Mukama Yesu. Nkikoze emirundi mingi, era olw'ekisa kye nkikola buli lunaku, ne Katonda amanyi nga bwe nkikola n'omutima gwonna, era nnina obujulizi bwa Katonda ku ekyo; mmanyi Katonda ampadde omukisa"? Tebannakakasibwa butakkiriza bwabwe. "Nga muli bantu basirusiru, ab'emitima eminafu egirwawo okukkiriza!" Omanyi Kristo kye yayogera ku muntu ayita muganda we omusirusiru? Naye wano Omwana wa Katonda ow'okwagala teyafuna kigambo kirala kya kugamba bayigirizwa be abaagalwa wabula nti: "Nga muli bantu basirusiru, ab'emitima eminafu egirwawo okukkiriza!" Oyagala Mukama Yesu akuwe okubikkulirwa kuno okujjuvu okwa yennyini? Oli mwetegefu okukkiriza nti obadde musirusiru olw'obutamukkirizanga? "Mukama Yesu, nsobezza nze. Oli awo, ng'oyaayaanira okunnina. Obadde awo n'ebisuubizo byo eby'obwesigwa, ng'olindirira okweraga." Wali owulidde ku muntu ayagala munne naye nga tayaayaanira kweraga gy'ali? Kristo ayaayaanira okweraga, naye tasobola olw'obutakkiriza bwaffe. Katonda atukakase obutakkiriza bwaffe, tukwatibwe ensonyi ddala era tumenyeke, tukaabe nti: "Ayi Katonda wange, kiki kino, omutima guno ogw'obutakkiriza oguteeka ekiziyiza mu luggi Kristo aleme kuyingira, oguzibikira amaaso gange nneme kulaba Yesu, ate nga ali kumpi bw'ati? Abadde wano emyaka kkumi oba abiri, ng'ampa buli kiseera omutima ogwaka, nga ndega ku katono ak'okwagala kwe n'ekisa kye, naye era sinnafuna kubikkulirwa kwa Yye, okunnina omutima gwange n'okubeera nange awatali kusalako." Woowe! Katonda atukakase obutakkiriza. Tukkirize, kubanga byonna bisoboka eri oyo akkiriza. Ekyo kigambo kya Katonda, era omukisa guno, okufuna okubikkulirwa kwa Yesu, gujja eri abo bokka abayiga okukkiriza n'okumwesiga. Waliwo akabonero akalala ak'abo okubikkulirwa kuno okw'enjawulo okwa Kristo kwe kunajjira, ke kano: tebawummula okutuusa lwe bakufuna. Mumanyi olugero. Emitima gyabwe gyali gyaka bwe baali basemberera ekifo gye baali bagenda, Kristo n'akola ng'agenda mu maaso. Yabagezesa; era singa baamuleka n'agenda mirembe, singa baamatira n'okulaba omutima ogwaka kwokka, bandifiiriddwa ekintu ekisinga obulungi obutagerekeka. Naye tebaamatira nakwo. Tebaamatira kuddayo eka ekiro ekyo eri abayigirizwa n'okugamba nti: "Woowe, olweggulo lwa mukisa lwe tubadde nalwo! Okuyigirizibwa okw'ekitalo kwe tufunye!" Nedda! Omutima ogwaka n'okulaba okwa mukisa byabaleetera okugamba nti: "Sula naffe," ne bamuwaliriza okuyingira. Baamuwaliriza okuyingira. Bulijjo kinzijukiza olugero lwa Yakobo: "Sijja kukuta nga tompadde mukisa." Olubereberye 32:26. Ogwo gwe mwoyo ogututegekera okubikkulirwa kwa Yesu. Owange mukwano gwange omwagalwa! Guno gwe gubadde omwoyo gwe tutunuuliddemu omukisa ogw'ekitalo gwe tumaze okuwulirako? "Ayi Mukama wange Yesu, newaakubadde sitegeera, newaakubadde sisobola kukikwata, n'okufuba kwange tekugasa, sijja kukuta ogende. Oba omwonoonyi ku nsi asobola okuba ne Yesu buli lunaku, buli ssaawa na buli kaseera, ng'abeera mu mutima gwe mu maanyi ag'okuzuukira, ng'ayakaayakana munda ye, ng'amujjuza okwagala n'essanyu; oba ekyo kisoboka, nkyagala." Ebyo bye bigambo byo? Woowe! Jjangu nno ogambe nti: "Mukama Yesu, sijja kukuta nga tompadde mukisa." Ekibuuzo kibuuzibwa emirundi mingi nnyo nti: "Nsonga ki eleetera obulamu bwa Bakristaayo bangi bwe buti okunafuwa?" Kiki ekituse? Kiki kye babulwa? Ng'Ekkanisa yaawulira katono okuyita kwa Kristo! Ng'Ekkanisa eri wala n'ekyo Kristo ky'andyagadde ebeere! Nsonga ki evudde ku mitawaana gyonna? Ebyokuddamu bingi biyinza okuweebwa, naye waliwo eky'okuddamu kimu ekigatta ebirala byonna, kye kino: buli mukkiriza abulwa okubikkulirwa okujjuvu okwa yekka okwa Kristo ow'oyekka nga Mukama abeera munda ye, ng'omugabo ogumumaliriza. Mukama Yesu bwe yali wano ku nsi, kiki ekyayawulanga abayigirizwa be n'abantu abalala? Yabaggya ku butimba bwabwe obw'okuvuba ne mu maka gaabwe, n'abakuŋŋaanyiza okumwetooloola, era baamanya Yesu. Ye yali Mukama waabwe ng'abakuuma, nabo nga bamugoberera. Era kiki ekinaayawulanga abayigirizwa ba Kristo — si abo abasuubira busuubizi okutuuka mu ggulu, naye abayigirizwa ba Kristo ab'omutima gwonna — n'abantu abalala? Kye kino: okubeera mu kussekimu ne Yesu buli ssaawa ey'olunaku. Era nga Kristo ku nsi bwe yasobola okukuuma abantu bali naye emyaka esatu, olunaku ku lunaku, bw'atyo Kristo kaakano asobola okukola okuva mu ggulu ekyo kye yali tasobola kukola ng'ali ku nsi: okukuuma okussekimu okusingira ddala okumpi ne buli mukkiriza mu nsi yonna. Ekitiibwa kibe eri Katonda! Mumanyi ekyawandiikibwa kiri ekya Abaefeso: "Oyo Kristo eyakka, ye wuuyo ddala eyalinnya ewala ennyo, n'ayisa waggulu w'eggulu lyonna, alyoke ajjule obwengula bw'ensi yonna." Abaefeso 4:10. Lwaki Mukama wange Yesu yatwalibwa mu ggulu okuva mu bulamu bw'ensi? Kubanga obulamu bw'ensi bulamu obusibiddwa mu bifo, naye obulamu obw'omu ggulu bulamu obutaliiko kkomo wala nsalo wala kifo; era Kristo yatwalibwa mu ggulu, mu maanyi ga Katonda, Katonda abeera wonna, alyoke asobole okujjuza buli muntu wano n'okubeera ne buli mukkiriza. Ekyo omutima gwange kye gwagala okufuna olw'okukkiriza; ekyo kisoboka, ekyo kisuubizo, ogwo gwe mugabo gwange ogw'obuzaale, era njagala okuba nagwo, era njagala olw'ekisa kya Katonda okugamba nti: "Yesu, sijja kuwummula okutuusa lw'oneeyanjulira ddala emmeeme yange." Emirundi mingi waliwo ebyokulabirako ebya mukisa nnyo mu bulamu obw'Ekikristaayo mu ddaala lye mpita eryokusatu: eddaala ly'omutima ogwaka. Mumanyi akabonero akalala akakulu ak'eddaala eryo? Okusanyukira Ekigambo kya Katonda. Abayigirizwa baafuna batya omutima ogwaka? Olw'okubikkulirwa Ebyawandiikibwa mu ngeri eri ey'ekitalo. Yafuula byonna okulabika nga bya njawulo era nga bipya, ne balaba bye baali batalabangako. Tebaayinza butawulira nga okuyigiriza kuli bwe kwali okw'ekitalo, okw'omu ggulu. Woowe! Waliwo Bakristaayo bangi ekiseera ekisinga obulungi eky'olunaku gye bali kye kiseera we basobolera okutuula ne Bayibuli zaabwe, era tewali kye baagala ng'okufuna ekirowoozo ekipya; era ng'omusimi wa almasi bw'asanyuka ng'azudde almasi, oba omusimi wa zaabu ng'azudde ekitole kya zaabu, bwe batyo basanyuka bwe baggya mu Bayibuli ekirowoozo ekipya, ne bakiriira. Naye wamu n'obwo obwagazi bwonna mu Kigambo kya Katonda, n'okwo okusanyuka kwonna okw'omutima, bwe bagenda mu byobusuubuzi byabwe oba ne bakola emirimu gyabwe egya buli lunaku, ekintu kimu kikyabulayo. Tusaana tuve mu mikisa emingi egya buli ngeri Yesu gy'asobola okugaba buli kiseera, tutuuke ku bumu obwa mukisa obw'eguno ogumu: nti Yesu yeeyanjula yennyini. Yesu Yennyini mwetegefu okweyanjula. Woowe! Singa mbuuzizza nti: "Kino si kye kintu ddala ggwe nange kye twagala, era abangi ku ffe kye tubadde twegomba?" nkakasa nti mwandizzeemu nti: "Ekyo kye njagala." Mulowooze ku mukisa oguliva mu ekyo. Emirundi mingi muyimba nti: "Woowe, emirembe Omulokozi wange gy'ampa! Emirembe gye nnali simanyangako, n'ekkubo lyange lyeyongedde okwaka kasookedde njiga okumwesiga ennyo." Juuzi nafuna ebbaluwa okuva eri omuntu ow'e Free State ng'egamba akatundu kali ak'oluyimba nga bwe kaali essuubi n'amaanyi ag'ekitalo wakati mu bizibu n'ennaku. Weewaawo; naye emirembe egyo gikuumibwa gitya? Kwali kubeerawo kwa Kristo okwaleeta emirembe. Omuyaga bwe gwali gugenda okumira abayigirizwa, kwali kubeerawo kwa Kristo Yennyini okwabawa emirembe. Owange Omukristaayo! Oyagala emirembe n'okuwummula? Oteekwa okuba ne Yesu Yennyini. Oyogera ku bulongoofu, oyogera ku kutukuzibwa n'okununulibwa okuva mu kibi. Katonda atenderezebwe: okununulibwa n'okutukuzibwa kuli wano, Yesu omulamu bw'ajja n'awa amaanyi. Awo tuba ne Kristo ono ow'okuzuukira, Kristo ono ow'omu ggulu ali ku ntebe ey'obwakabaka, nga yeeyanjula gye tuli. Mazima ddala ekyo kye kinaabeera ekyama ky'obulongoofu era ekyama ky'amaanyi. Amaanyi g'abangi gava wa? Mu ssanyu ery'omukwano ogwa yekka ne Yesu. Abayigirizwa bali, singa baddayo n'emitima gyabwe egyaka eri abayigirizwa abalala, bandibategeezza ebintu eby'ekitalo ku musajja eyabannyonnyola Ebyawandiikibwa n'ebisuubizo, naye tebandisobodde kugamba nti: "Tulabye Yesu." Bandiyinzizza okugamba nti: "Yesu mulamu; ekyo tulina obukakafu," naye ekyo tekyandimatizza balala. Naye kaakano baali basobola okugenda n'okugamba nti: "Tumulabye Yye Yennyini. Yeeyanjudde gye tuli." Ffenna tusanyuka okukolera Kristo, naye waliwo okwemulugunya mu Kkanisa yonna eya Kristo, okuva ku basumba mu mimbala okutuuka ku mukozi asingira ddala obunafu: obutaba na ssanyu n'obutaba na mukisa. Tugezeeko okunoonyereza oba nga wano si we wali ekyama: nti Mukama Yesu ajje yeeyanjule gye tuli nga Mukama waffe ayogere naffe. Bwe tuba ne Yesu naffe, era bwe tutambula buli kigere nga tulowooza nti Yesu y'ayagala tugende, nti Yesu y'atutuma era y'atuyamba, awo wanaabeerawo okwakaayakana mu bujulizi bwaffe, era bunaayamba abakkiriza abalala, nabo banaatandika okutegeera nti: "Kaakano ndabye ensonga lwaki nnalemererwa. Nnatwala ekigambo, nnatwala omukisa, ne ntwala, nga bwe nnalowooza, obulamu, naye nnali sirina Yesu omulamu." Bw'obuuza kaakano nti: "Okubikkulirwa kuno kunajja kutya?" Muganda wange, mwannyinaze: ekyo kye kyama omuntu yenna ky'atayinza kwogera, Yesu ky'yeekuumira yekka. Mu maanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu Kristo, Omuzuukufu, mwe yayingirira obulamu obupya. Obulamu bwe obw'okuzuukira bwa njawulo ddala n'obulamu bwe obwaliwo ng'akyali kufa. Mumanyi kye tusoma nti: "ne bamutegeera." Lukka 24:31. Yeeraga, oluvannyuma n'abulawo. Era okulaba kuli okwa Kristo kwali kwa muwendo bwe gutyo? Kwabula mu kaseera katono. Kwali kwa muwendo gwa ggulu, gwa milembe na milembe, gwa buli kintu. Lwaki? Kubanga okuva olwo Kristo teyali wa kumanyibwa nate mu ngeri ya mubiri. Okuva olwo Kristo yali mu maanyi g'Omwoyo, agajjuza eggulu; mu maanyi g'Omwoyo, ge maanyi g'Obwakatonda; mu maanyi g'Omwoyo, agajjuza emitima gyaffe. Okuva olwo Kristo yali wa kubeera mu bulamu obw'omu ggulu. Katonda yeebazibwe, Kristo asobola, mu maanyi g'Omwoyo Omutukuvu, okweraga eri buli omu ku ffe; naye, muganda wange, kigambo kya kyama wakati wa Kristo naawe. Twala obukakafu buno: "Amaaso gaabwe ne gazibuka ne bamutegeera," era okkirize nti bwawandiikirwa ggwe. Ogamba nti: "Mmanyi amadaala amalala asatu: eddaala ly'omutima ogunakuwavu, nga nkungubaga nti saamanya Kristo omulamu; mmanyi eddaala ly'omutima omunafu okukkiriza, bwe nnalwana n'obutakkiriza bwange; era mmanyi eddaala ly'omutima ogwaka, awali ebiseera ebikulu eby'essanyu n'omukisa." Ogamba bw'otyo? Jjangu nno omanye eddaala eryokuna: ery'omutima ogumativu, omutima ogusanyusibbwa emirembe gyonna, omutima ogutasobola kuziyiza ssanyu lyagwo, naye oguddayo e Yerusaalemi ne gugamba nti: "Kya mazima. Yesu yeeraze. Nkimanyi, nkiwulira." Owange muganda wange! Owange mwannyinaze! Okubikkulirwa kuno kunajja kutya? Yesu ajja kukubuulira. Jjangu eri Mukama Yesu, ossekimu mu maaso ge okusaba okwangu okw'ekyana, nange, omuweereza we, nnajja ne nkukwata ku mukono ne ŋŋamba nti: "Jjangu; omulimu gwange guwedde. Ndaze Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda, Omuzuukufu. Omulimu gwange guwedde." Tuyingire mu Maaso Amatukuvu, otandike — oba tonnakunoonya — otandike okwegayirira nti: "Ayi Omulokozi! Mbeere n'omukisa guno buli kaseera wamu nange: Yesu Yennyini, omugabo gwange emirembe gyonna." "Yesu Yennyini." "Ndi nammwe bulijjo."

fields.title: Ndijja ne mbeera nammwe, era siribaleka emirembe gyonna
fields.body_html:
Bwe ndowooza ku kulwana kwonna, ebizibu, n'okulemererwa abangi kwe beemulugunya, ne ku luyimba olw'ebigambo ebyangu ennyo n'omwana omuto by'asobola okutegeera, ekyama ky'obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo kye kiruwa? Awo ekirowoozo ne kinzijira: nsobola okusuubira nti nnaaweebwa okutwala oyo Mukama Yesu ow'ekitiibwa, ow'omu ggulu, owa Katonda, ne mulaga emmeeme zino zisobole okumulaba mu kitiibwa kye? Era nnaaweebwa okuzibula amaaso gaabwe balabe nti waliwo Kristo owa Katonda, Ayinzabyonna, ayingira ddala mu mutima era asuubiza n'obwesigwa nti: "Ndijja ne mbeera nammwe, era Ndi nammwe bulijjo"? Matayo 28:20.

Nedda; ebigambo byange tebisobola kukola ekyo. Naye awo ne ndowooza nti: Mukama wange Yesu asobola okunkozesa ng'omuweereza owabulijjo okukwata abanafu ku mukono, okubagumya, n'okubayamba okugamba nti: Jjangu, jjangu, jjangu mu maaso ga Yesu omulindirire, era ajja kweyoleka gy'oli. Nsaba Katonda akozese Ekigambo kye eky'omuwendo. Kwe kubeerawo kwa Mukama Yesu kwokka.

Ekyo kye kyama ky'amaanyi n'essanyu ly'Omukristaayo. Mumanyi nti bwe yali ku nsi, yabeeranga mu mubiri n'abayigirizwa be. Baatambulanga wamu olunaku lwonna, ekiro ne bagenda mu nnyumba y'emu, era oluusi baasulanga wamu ne balya ne banywa wamu. Baabeeranga wamu bulijjo. Okubeerawo kwa Yesu kwe kwali essomero ly'abayigirizwa be. Baali banyweredde mu Yye olw'omukwano ogwo ogw'ekitalo okumala emyaka esatu emiwanvu, era mu mukwano ogwo ne bayiga okumanya Kristo, ne Kristo n'abayigiriza n'abagolola, n'abategekera bye baali bagenda okufuna oluvannyuma. Kaakano ng'agenda, abagamba nti: "Era Ndi nammwe bulijjo n'okutuukira ddala ensi lw'eriggwaawo." Matayo 28:20.

Nga kya kisuubizo! Era nga Kristo bwe yali ddala ne Peetero mu lyato, nga Kristo bwe yatuula ddala ne Yokaana ku mmeeza, bwe ntyo ddala bwe nsobola okuba ne Kristo nange. Era n'okusingawo, kubanga bo baalina Kristo waabwe mu mubiri, era gye bali yali muntu, omuntu eyeeyawudde ku bo; naye nze nsobola okuba ne Kristo agulumizibbwa mu maanyi g'entebe ey'obwakabaka eya Katonda, Kristo Ayinzabyonna, era Kristo abeera wonna.

Nga kya kisuubizo! Mumbuuza nti: ekyo kisoboka kitya? N'eky'okuddamu kyange kye kino: kubanga Kristo ye Katonda, era kubanga Kristo, bwe yamala okufuuka omuntu, yalinnya ku ntebe ey'obwakabaka ne mu Bulamu bwa Katonda. Era kaakano oyo Kristo Yesu ow'omukisa, ow'omutima ogw'okwagala ogwafumitibwa; oyo Yesu Kristo ow'omukisa eyabeera ku nsi; Kristo oyo omu agulumizibbwa mu kitiibwa kya Katonda, asobola okubeera mu nze era asobola okubeera nange ennaku zonna.

Mugamba nti: "Ddala kisoboka omusajja ali mu by'obusuubuzi, omukazi ali wakati mu maka amanene agalimu emirimu emingi, omwavu ajjudde okweraliikirira? Kisoboka? Nsobola okulowoozanga ku Yesu bulijjo?" Katonda yeebazibwe, teweetaaga kumulowoozangako bulijjo. Oyinza okuba omukulu wa bbanka, era okufaayo kwo kwonna kuyinza okwetaagibwa okutwala emirimu gy'olina okukola.

Naye Katonda yeebazibwe: nze bwe mba nnina okulowooza ku mirimu gyange, Yesu anaalowooza ku nze, era anaayingira n'antwala mu buvunaanyizibwa bwe.

Omwana oyo omuto ow'emyezi esatu, bw'aba yeebase mu mikono gya nnyina, agalamira awo nga talina buyambi; nnyina amumanyiiko katono, tamulowoozaako, naye nnyina alowooza ku mwana. Era kino kye kyama ekya mukisa eky'okwagala: nti Yesu, Katonda-Omuntu, alindirira okuyingira mu nze mu bukulu bw'okwagala kwe; era bw'atwala omutima gwange, ampambaatira mu mikono egyo egya Katonda n'aŋŋamba nti: "Mwana wange, Nze Omwesigwa, Nze Ow'amaanyi, nnaabeeranga naawe, nnaakulabiriranga ne nkukuumanga ennaku zonna."

Aŋŋamba nti anaayingira mu mutima gwange ndyoke mbeere Omukristaayo omusanyufu, Omukristaayo omutukuvu, era Omukristaayo ow'omugaso. Mugamba nti: Woowe! Singa nnandisobodde okukkiriza ekyo, singa nnandirowoozezza nti kisoboka okuba ne Kristo bulijjo, buli ssaawa na buli kaseera nga ali nange, ng'antwala era ng'ankuuma mu buvunaanyizibwa bwe!

Muganda wange, mwannyinaze, kye nkutegeeza kye kino kyennyini. Yesu bwe yagamba abayigirizwa be nti: "Ndi nammwe bulijjo," yakyogera mu bujjuvu bw'okubeera wonna okwa Katonda, mu bujjuvu bw'okwagala kwa Katonda, era ayaayaana okweyoleka gy'oli ekiro kino.

Kaakano lowooza katono: ng'obwo bulamu bwa mukisa, okubeerawo kwa Yesu bwe kubeerera awo bulijjo! Ekyo si kye kyama ky'emirembe n'essanyu? Singa nnandituuse (buli mutima bwe gwogera bwe gutyo) ku mbeera eyo eya mukisa, buli lunaku era olunaku lwonna nga mpulira Yesu ng'andabirira era ng'ankuuma bulijjo, woowe, mirembe ki gye nnandibadde nagyo mu kirowoozo kino: "Sirina kye neeraliikirira Yye bw'anfaako, era sirina kye ntya Yye bw'ampa bye neetaaga." Omutima gwo gugamba nti kino kirungi nnyo okuba ekya mazima, era kya kitiibwa nnyo okuba ekikyo. Naye era okkiriza nti kiteekwa okuba ekya mukisa nnyo.

Ggwe atya, ggwe akyamye, ggwe eyeeraliikirira: nkuleetedde ekisuubizo kya Katonda; kyange era kikyo. Yesu ajja kukikola; nga Katonda, asobola, era Yesu mwetegefu era ayaayaana, ng'Eyakomererwa, okukukuuma mu mirembe egituukiridde. Kino kya mazima eky'ekitalo, era kye kyama ky'essanyu eritayogerekeka. Era kino nakyo kye kyama ky'Obutukuvu.

Mu kifo ky'ekibi ekibeera munda, Kristo abeera munda n'akiwangula; mu kifo ky'ekibi ekibeera munda, obulamu n'ekitangaala n'okwagala eby'Omwana wa Katonda ow'omukisa nga bibeera munda. Yye ye kyama ky'obutukuvu. "Kristo Yesu, eyafuuka amagezi gye tuli okuva eri Katonda, bwe butuukirivu, n'okutukuzibwa" 1 Abakkolinso 1:30. Mujjukire nti Kristo Yennyini ye yafuuka okutukuzibwa kwaffe. Kristo ng'ayingira mu nze, ng'atwala obuvunaanyizibwa bw'obulamu bwange bwonna: obuzaaliranwa bwange n'ebirowoozo byange n'okwagala kwange n'okusalawo kwange; ng'afuga byonna. Kino kye kinanfuula omutukuvu. Twogera ku butukuvu, naye mumanyi obutukuvu kye buli? Olina obutukuvu nga bw'olina Kristo, kubanga kyawandiikibwa nti: "Oyo atukuza era n'abo abatukuzibwa bava mu omu bonna" (Abaebbulaniya 2:11), era Kristo atukuza ng'aleeta obulamu bwa Katonda mu nze.

Tusoma mu Balam 6:34 nti: "Omwoyo wa Mukama Katonda n'akka ku Gidyoni." Naye mumanyi nti mu Ndagaano Empya waliwo ekyawandiikibwa eky'ekitalo bwe kityo, we tusoma nti: "Twambale Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo" (Abaruumi 13:14), kwe kugamba: weyambaze Kristo Yesu. Ekyo kitegeeza ki? Tekitegeeza kubalirwa butuukirivu obuli ebweru wange kyokka, naye okwambala empisa ennamu eza Kristo omulamu, okwagala okulamu okwa Kristo omulamu. Yambala Mukama Yesu.

Woowe! Mirimu ki? Sisobola kukikola okuggyako nga nkkiriza era nga ntegeera nti Oyo gwe nnina okwambala ali ng'ekyambalo ekibikka obulamu bwange bwonna. Nnina okwambala Kristo omulamu eyagamba nti: "Ndi nammwe bulijjo." Matayo 28:20.

Weesibeko busibi amakanzu g'ekyambalo ekyo eky'ekitangaala Kristo ky'ayagala okukwambaza.

Jjangu bujji okkirize nti Kristo ali naawe, ali ku ggwe, era ali mu ggwe. Woowe, mwambale! Era bw'otunuulira empisa ze emu ku emu; n'owulira ekigambo kya Katonda nti: "Mubengamu endowooza eri eyali mu Kristo Yesu" (Abafiripi 2:5), ne kikutegeeza nti yagondera n'okutuusa ku kufa; awo n'oddamu nti: Kristo omugonvu, Kristo eyalina obulamu bwonna nga bwa kugondera, oyo ye Kristo gwe nnafuna era gwe nnambala. Afuuka obulamu bwange, n'obugonvu bwe bubeera ku nze okutuusa lwe njiga okwogera mpolampola nga Yesu bwe yakola nti: "Kitange, by'oyagala bye binaakolebwa; ekyanzigya mu ggulu kwe kukola ekyo Katonda eyantuma ky'ayagala, so si Nze bye njagala ku bwange." Yokaana 6:38.

Kino nakyo kye kyama ky'amaanyi mu bujulizi ne mu mulimu. Kiki ekizibuwalira okugondera, era lwaki nnyonoona emirundi mingi bwe gityo? Abantu bayimba nti: "Woowe, okuba owuwo ddala," era bakiyimba okuva ku mutima. Kiki ekibafuula abajeemu nate? Obujeemu buva wa?

Era eky'okuddamu kye kino. Kubanga ngezaako okugondera Kristo ali ewala, n'olwekyo ebiragiro bye tebijja na maanyi. Mulabe kye nsanga mu Kigambo kya Katonda. Katonda bwe yayagalanga okutuma omuntu yenna mu mulimu gwe, yasookanga okumusisinkana n'okwogera naye, n'amugumyanga omulundi n'omulundi. Katonda yalabikira Ibulayimu emirundi musanvu oba munaana n'amuwa ekiragiro kimu oluvannyuma lw'ekirala, bw'atyo Ibulayimu n'ayiga okumugondera ddala. Katonda yalabikira Yoswa ne Gidyoni, nabo ne bagondera.

Naye lwaki ffe tetugondera? Kubanga tulina katono nnyo ak'omukwano guno ogw'okumpi ne Yesu.

Singa twamanya ekyama kino ekya mukisa, eky'omu ggulu, eky'okuba n'okubeerawo kwa Kristo naffe buli lunaku, buli ssaawa, buli ddakiika, nga kyandibadde ssanyu okugondera! Tetwandisobodde kutambula mu kutegeera kuno: "Mukama wange Yesu ali nange era anneetoolodde," ne tutamugondera! Woowe, totandika kwegomba n'okugamba nti: kino kye nteekwa okuba nakyo, okubeerawo kwa Yesu okubeerera awo bulijjo! Waliwo Abakristaayo abamu abagezaako obutaba bajeemu, abajja eri emirimu gyabwe egya Ssande n'egya wakati mu wiiki n'obwesigwa bungi, ne basaba ekisa n'omukisa, era beemulugunya olw'omukisa omutono ennyo n'amaanyi amatono, amaanyi matono nnyo! Lwaki? Kubanga temuli Yesu mulamu amala mu mitima gyabwe.

Oluusi ndowooza ku kino ng'amazima agasinga obuzito. Waliwo enjawulo nnene ey'ebirabo mu basumba ne mu balala aboogera, naye nkakasa kino: nti ebirabo by'omuntu si kye kipimo ky'amaanyi ge amazima. Nkakasa kino: nti Katonda asobola okulaba ekyo ggwe nange kye tutasobola kulaba.

Oluusi abantu bawulirako katono, naye ng'omuntu bw'aba nakyo mu mazima — si ng'enneewulira, oba okwegomba, oba ekirowoozo, naye mu mazima — omwoyo gwennyini n'okubeerawo kwa Yesu nga biri ku ye, muva amaanyi agatalabika, agasirise. Amaanyi ago ag'ekyama kwe kubeerawo Okutukuvu okwa Yesu. "Ndi nammwe bulijjo." Matayo 28:20. Kaakano, oba bye njogedde bimaze okulaga nga bwe kiri ekintu ekyegombebwa, nga bwe kiri ekya mukisa okukibeererawo, kale kaakano ka mbawe eky'okuddamu ky'ekibuuzo ekizuukira mu mitima egisukka mu gumu. Mpulira omuntu ng'agamba nti: "Mbuulira engeri gye nnyinza okufuna okubeerawo kuno okwa mukisa okwa Yesu okubeerera awo; era bwe nnaamala okukufuna, engeri gye nnyinza okukukuuma. Ndowooza bwe mba na kino, mba na byonna.

Mukama Yesu ansemberedde nnyo. Ngezezzaako okuva ku buli kintu ekiyinza okunziyiza, era mbadde ne Mukama wange kumpi nnyo. Naye nnaamanya ntya nti anaabeeranga nange bulijjo?" Singa wabuuzizza Mukama nti: "Ayi Mukama wange Kristo ow'omukisa, nkole ki? Nnyinza ntya okusanyukira okubeerawo kwo okutaggwaawo?" eky'okuddamu kye ekisooka kyandibadde nti: "Kkiriza kyokka. Nkyogedde emirundi mingi, n'okitegeera kitundu butundu, naye nnaakyogera nate: Mwana wange, kkiriza kyokka." Kuba kwa kukkiriza.

Oluusi twogera ku kukkiriza ng'obwesige, era kya mugaso nnyo okugamba abantu nti okukkiriza bwe bwesige; naye abantu bwe bagamba, nga bwe bagamba oluusi, nti si kirala wabula bwesige bwokka, ekyo si kituufu. Kigambo kigazi nnyo okusinga obwesige. Kuba kwa kukkiriza kwe njigira okumanya Oyo atalabika, Katonda atalabika, ne mulaba. Okukkiriza ge maaso gange ag'omwoyo ku ebyo ebitalabika n'eby'omu ggulu. Emirundi mingi ofuba nnyo okwesiga Katonda, n'olemererwa. Lwaki? Kubanga tosoose kutwala kiseera kulaba Katonda. Osobola otya okwesiga Katonda ddala nga tonnamusisinkana n'okumumanya? Obuuza nti: "Ntandikira wa?" Osaana otandike ng'okkiriza okusooka, ng'weeyanjula mu maaso ga Katonda ono mu mbeera y'okusinza okusirise, n'omusaba akkirize okuwulira okw'obukulu bwe n'okubeerawo kwe kukujjire. Oteekwa okumusaba omutima gwo gubikkibwe n'okubeerawo kwe okutukuvu. Oteekwa okunoonya okufuula okubeerawo kwa Katonda Ayinzabyonna era ajjudde okwagala okuba okwa mazima mu mutima gwo, Katonda ow'okwagala okutayogerekeka.

Twala ekiseera okumusinza nga Katonda ayinzabyonna, okuwulira nti amaanyi gennyini agaatonda ensi, amaanyi gennyini agaazuukiza Yesu mu bafu, mu kaseera kano gakolera mu mutima gwo.

Tetukifunako bukakafu kubanga tetukikkiriza. Tuteekwa okutwala ekiseera okukkiriza. Yesu agamba nti: "Woowe mwana wange, ziba amaaso go eri ensi, oggye mu mutima gwo ebirowoozo bino byonna ebikwata ku ddiini, otandike okukkiriza Katonda Yennyini." Eyo y'ennyingo esooka ey'Okukkiriza: "Nzikiriza Katonda."

Nga nkkiriza, nziggulawo omutima gwange okusembeza Katonda ono ow'ekitiibwa, ne nkutama ne nsinza. Era nga nkikkiriza kino, ntunula waggulu ne ndaba Omwana gw'Endiga ku Ntebe ey'Obwakabaka, ne nkkiriza nti amaanyi ga Katonda Ayinzabyonna gali mu Yesu lwa nsonga eyo yennyini: okubikkulira omutima gwange okubeerawo kwe. Lwaki waliwo babiri ku Ntebe ey'Obwakabaka? Katonda tamala? Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda ali ku Ntebe ey'Obwakabaka ku lulwo era ku lwange; Omwana gw'Endiga ali ku Ntebe ey'Obwakabaka ye Kristo Yennyini, ng'alina amaanyi nga Katonda okuntwala. Woowe, tolowooza nti tosobola kufuna kutegeera okwo. Era tokulowooza ng'okuli kumpi naawe kaakano kwokka, naye kuza empisa ey'okukkiriza. "Yesu, nzikiriza ekitiibwa kyo; nzikiriza okuyinzabyonna kwo; nzikiriza amaanyi go agakolera munda yange. Nzikiriza okubeerawo kwo okulamu, okw'okwagala, nga kuli nange, nga kweyoleka mu maanyi ga Katonda."

Teweeraliikiriranga nneewulira wadde ebyokulabirako. Ojja kukiraba nga kyangu nnyo era nga kwewulira bwesige bwereere n'okugamba nti: "Nkakasa nti Yye wange ddala mu byonna." Weerabire wekka okumala akaseera; teweerowoozangako wadde okweyogerako, naye lowooza ku ekyo Yesu ky'ali. N'oluvannyuma jjukira: bulijjo kkiriza. Oluusi mpulira nga sisobola kufuna bigambo bya kutegeeza Katonda nga bw'ayagala abantu be okukkiriza okuva enkya okutuusa ekiro. Buli mukka gwe tussa gwandibadde bukkirizi bwereere. Weewaawo, kya mazima ddala; Mukama Yesu ayagala tubeerenga mu kukkiriza kwokka okuva enkya okutuusa akawungeezi, era oteekwa okutandika okufuula ekyo ekintu ekikulu mu bulamu.

Bw'ozuukuka enkya, omutima gwo gufulume n'okukkiriza okunene mu kino, ne mu makesa g'ekiro ekirowoozo kino kibeere naawe: Omulokozi wange Yesu anneetoolodde era ali kumpi nange; era osobola okutunula waggulu n'ogamba nti: "Njagala kukwesiganga bulijjo." Omanyi obwesige kye buli. Kiwoomerera nnyo okwesiga. Era tosobola kaakano kwesiga Yesu, okubeerawo kuno, okubeerawo kuno okukuuma? Abeera mulamu ku lulwo mu Ggulu. Oteekeddwako akabonero k'omusaayi gwe, era akwagala; era tosobola kugamba nti: "Kabaka wange, Kabaka wange, Yye ali nange ennaku zonna"? Woowe, weesige Yesu okutuukiriza ebisuubizo bye yennyini. Waliwo eky'okuddamu ekyokubiri ndowooza Kristo kye yandiwadde singa tujja gy'ali nga tukkiriza ne tugamba nti: "Waliwo ekirala, Mukama wange ow'omukisa?" Ndowooza mpulira eky'okuddamu kye: "Mwana wange, gonderanga bulijjo."

Tolema kutegeera kisomesebwa ekiri mu kigambo kino ekimu. Oteekwa okutwala ddala ekigambo ekyo GONDERA, n'obugonvu, n'oyiga okwogera ku bwo wekka nti: "Kaakano nnina okugondera, era olw'ekisa kya Katonda nnaagondera mu buli kintu."

Ku mwoleso gwaffe oguwedde e Cape, Omwami Rhodes, Katikkiro waffe, yagenda ku mulyango ng'alowooza nti yalina ensimbi z'okuyingira mu nsawo ye. Naye bwe yatuuka ku mulyango, yasanga nga talina nsimbi zimala, n'agamba omukuumi w'omulyango nti: "Nze Mwami Rhodes; nzikiriza nnyingire, era nnaalaba nga tofiirwa." Naye omusajja n'agamba nti: "Sisobola kukiyamba, ssebo; nnina ebiragiro byange," n'agaana Omwami Rhodes okuyingira. Kyamugwanira okwewola ku mukwano gwe n'asasula n'alyoka ayita mu mulyango. Oluvannyuma ku kyekiro, Omwami Rhodes yakyogerako n'agamba nti kyali ssanyu lya mazima okulaba omuntu ng'anywerera ku kiragiro kye bw'atyo. Bwe kityo bwe kiri. Omusajja yalina ebiragiro bye, era ekyo kyamumala, era buli eyajjanga ku mulyango yalina okusasula ensimbi ze ez'okuyingira n'alyoka ayingira. Abaana ba Katonda basaana okuba ng'abaserikale, nga beetegefu okugamba nti: "Nteekwa okugondera."

Woowe! Okuba n'ekirowoozo ekyo mu mitima gyaffe: "Yesu, njagala okukugondera." Wateekwa okubaawo omukwano ogw'obuntu n'Omulokozi, n'oluvannyuma ne lujja essanyu ly'okuweereza okw'obuntu n'obwesigwa. Oli mwetegefu okugondera mu bunafu bwonna n'obuyinike n'okutya? Osobola okugamba nti: "Weewaawo, Mukama Yesu, nnaagondera"? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, weewengayo ddala. Awo enneewulira yo eneebeera nti: "Sijja kwogera kigambo na kimu bwe mba ndowooza nti Yesu tandyagadde kukiwulira. Sijja kubeera na ndowooza yange ku bwange, naye obulamu bwange bwonna bunaabikkibwa n'obulongoofu bw'obugonvu bwe eri Kitaffe n'okwagala kwe okwewaayo ku lwange. Njagala Kristo abeere n'obulamu bwange bwonna, omutima gwange gwonna, empisa zange zonna. Njagala okufaanana Kristo n'okugondera." Weewengayo eri obugonvu buno obw'okwagala.

Ekirowoozo ekyokusatu kye kino: bwe ŋŋamba nti: "Mukama wange, Omulokozi ow'omukisa, mbuulira byonna: nnaakkiriza, ngondera, era nnaagondera. Waliwo ekirala kye nneetaaga okwekakasiza essanyu ly'okubeerawo kwo okubeerera awo?" ne mpulira eky'okuddamu kino: "Mwana wange, omukwano ogw'okumpi nange buli lunaku."

Aa, awo we wali ensobi y'abangi abagezaako okugondera ne bagezaako okukkiriza; bakikola mu maanyi gaabwe, era tebamanyi nti Mukama Yesu bw'aba anaafuga mu mitima gyabwe, bateekwa okuba n'okussekimu okw'okumpi naye buli lunaku. Tosobola kukola byonna by'ayagala, naye Yesu ajja kubikukolera.

Waliwo Abakristaayo bangi abalemererwa wano, era olw'ensonga eyo tebategeera kye kiri okuba n'okussekimu ne Yesu. Ka ngezeeko okubakakasa kino: Katonda abawadde Omulokozi ow'okwagala, omulamu; era anaakuwa atya omukisa nga tomusisinkana? Essanyu ly'omukwano lisangibwa mu kussekimu; era Yesu asaba kino buli lunaku, alyoke afune ekiseera eky'okunkwatako, eky'okumbuulira ebibye yennyini, eky'okunjigiriza, eky'okunfuuwamu Omwoyo we, eky'okumpa obulamu obupya n'essanyu n'amaanyi.

Era mujjukire: okussekimu ne Yesu tekitegeeza kitundu kya ssaawa, oba essaawa emu mu kasenge ko. Omuntu ayinza okusoma Bayibuli ye oba ekitabo kye eky'ennyinnyonnyola n'obwegendereza; ayinza okunoonya ennyiriri zonna ezikwatagana mu ssuula; bw'afuluma mu kasenge ke ayinza okukubuulira byonna ebikikwatako, naye ng'asisinkanye Yesu enkya eyo n'akatono. Osabye eddakiika ttaano oba kkumi, naye tosisinkanye Yesu. Bwe tutyo tuteekwa okujjukira nti newaakubadde Bayibuli ya muwendo nnyo nnyini, n'okugisoma kya mukisa nnyo era kyetaagisa, okusaba n'okusoma Bayibuli si kwe kussekimu ne Yesu.

Kye twetaaga buli nkya kwe kusisinkana Yesu n'okugamba nti: "Mukama, olunaku luzze nate, era ndi munafu mu nze nzekka nga bwe nabanga bulijjo; jjangu ondiise ku ggwe wennyini enkya eno, oyogere n'emmeeme yange." Woowe mikwano gyange, si kukkiriza kwammwe kunaabayimirizaawo, naye Yesu omulamu, gwe musisinkana buli lunaku mu kussekimu, mu kusinza ne mu kwagala. Lindirira mu maaso ge, ne bw'owulira ng'oli wa mpewo era nga tolina kukkiriza. Lindirira mu maaso ge ogambe nti: "Mukama, nga bwe siriiko kye nsobola, nzikiriza era mpummulira mu bukakafu obwa mukisa nti ky'osuubizza ojja kukinkolera."

Mbuuza Mukama wange omulundi omulala nti: "Mukama Yesu, ebyo bye byonna?" N'eky'okuddamu kye kiri nti: "Nedda, mwana wange; nnina ekintu kimu ekirala." "Era kye kiruwa? Oŋŋambye okukkiriza, n'okugondera, n'okubeera kumpi naawe: kiki ekirala ky'oyagala?" "Nkolera, mwana wange. Jjukira, nakununula lwa kuweereza Kwange; nakununula obeere omujulirwa afuluma mu nsi ng'onjatula mu maaso g'abantu." Woowe, tokweka kyobugagga kyo, so tolowooza nti Yesu bw'aba naawe osobola okukikweka.

Ekintu kimu ku bibiri kijja kubaawo: oba oteekwa okuleka byonna, oba kiteekwa okufuluma.

Oboolyawo wawulira ku muwala omuto eyasangibwa, oluvannyuma lw'olumu ku nkuŋŋaana za Mwami Moody, ng'ayimba ezimu ku nnyimba ffenna ze tumanyi. Abazadde b'omwana baali balina ekifo ekirungi mu bantu, era bwe yali ng'ayimba ennyimba ezo mu ddiiro, nnyina n'amugaana. Olunaku lumu yali ng'ayimba oluyimba "Woowe, nsanyuka nnyo Yesu okunjagala," nnyina n'agamba nti: "Mwana wange, kiki ekikuyimbisa luno so nga nnakugaana?" N'addamu nti: "Woowe maama, sisobola kukyewala; kifuluma kyokka." Yesu Kristo bw'aba mu mutima, ateekwa okufuluma.

Mujjukire: si buvunaanyizibwa bwaffe bwokka okumwatula; kiri bwe kityo, naye kiriko n'ekisingawo.

Bw'otokikola, kaba kabonero kokka nti teweewaddeyo eri Yesu: empisa zo, erinnya lyo, ne byonna by'olina. Omumma ekintu. Oteekwa okwatula Yesu mu nsi, mu maka go, ne buli wantu. Omanyi ekiragiro kya Mukama nti: "Mugende mu nsi zonna mubuulire Enjiri eri ebitonde byonna." "Era laba, Ndi nammwe," ekitegeeza nti: "Omuntu yenna ayinza okunkolera, era nnaabeeranga naye." Kya mazima eri omusumba, eri omuminsani, n'eri buli mukkiriza akolera Yesu. Okubeerawo kwa Yesu kukwatagana nnyo n'omulimu ogumukolerwa. Ogamba nti: "Sikirowoozangako. Nnina omulimu gwange ogwa Ssande, naye mu wiiki sikola mulimu ku lulwe."

Tosobola kuba na kubeerawo kwa Yesu n'oleka kino okweyongera okuba bwe kityo. Sikkiriza nti wandisobodde okuba n'okubeerawo kwa Yesu wiiki yonna naye n'otamukolerako kintu na kimu; noolwekyo, amagezi gange ge gano: kolera Oyo asaanira; omukisa gwe n'okubeerawo kwe binaasangibwa mu mulimu. Kya mukisa okukolera Kristo mu nsi eno ezikirira. Woowe, lwaki emitima gyaffe emirundi mingi giwulira nga mpewo era nga migale, n'abangi ku ffe ne tugamba nti: "Simpulira nga nyitiddwa mu mulimu gwa Kristo"? Beera mwetegefu okwewaayo eri okuweereza kwa Mukama, era ajja kweyoleka gy'oli.

Kristo ajja n'ekisuubizo kye eky'ekitalo, era ky'agamba, akigamba abakkiriza bonna: "Ndi nammwe bulijjo; ekyo kye kisuubizo Kyange; kino Nze mu maanyi Gange kye nsobola okukola; kino kye nneesiba n'obwesigwa okutuukiriza; onookikkiriza? Neewaayo gy'oli, ggwe emmeeme." Eri buli omu ku abo abazze gy'ali, Kristo agamba nti: "Neewaayo gy'oli, okuba owuwo ddala era owuwo yenna buli ssaawa eya buli lunaku; okubeera naawe era mu ggwe buli kaseera, okukuwa omukisa n'okukuwanirira, n'okukuwa buli kaseera okutegeera okubeerawo Kwange; nnaabeera owuwo ddala, ddala, ddala." Kaakano, oludda olulala lwe luluwa? Ayagala nze mbeere Owuwe ddala. Oli mwetegefu okutwala kino ng'ekigambo kyo eky'omusingi kaakano: "Wa Katonda ddala"?

Ayi Katonda, fuuwa okubeerawo kwo mu mutima gwange olyoke oyakire okuva mu bulamu bwange. "Wa Katonda ddala": kino kibeere ekigambo kyaffe eky'omusingi. Mujje twevuunike wansi mu maaso g'ebigere bye. Omuminsani waffe ow'e Nyasalandi agamba nti emirundi mingi akwatibwako okulaba engeri Abakristaayo ab'omu kitundu, bwe baleetebwa eri Yesu, gye batayimirira mu kusaba; tebafukamira, naye beesuula wansi ku ttaka n'ebyenyi byabwe okutuuka ku ttaka, ne bagalamira awo, ne bakaabirira Katonda mu maloboozi ag'omwanguka.

Oluusi mpulira nga nandyagadde ffe ffennyini tusobole okukola ekyo, naye tetukyetaaga. Ka tukikole mu mwoyo, kubanga Omwana wa Katonda ow'emirembe n'emirembe azze mu mitima gyaffe. Onoomutwala n'omukuuma omwo, okumuwa ekitiibwa n'okumuleka akole nga bw'ayagala? Jjangu kaakano ogambe nti: "Nnaakunoonya n'omutima gwange gwonna; ndi wuwo ddala."

Weeweyo gy'ali ddala akutwalire ddala. Ajja kukutwala era akuume okukutwala okwo.

Jjangu kaakano. Yesu asanyukira okusinza kw'Abatukuvu be. Obulamu bwaffe bwonna busobola okufuuka ekikolwa kimu ekitasalako eky'okusinza n'omulimu ogw'okwagala n'essanyu, bwe tunajjukiranga ne tussa ekitiibwa mu kino: nti Yesu yagamba nti: "Ndi nammwe bulijjo n'okutuukira ddala ensi lw'eriggwaawo." Matayo 28:20.
fields.body_text: Bwe ndowooza ku kulwana kwonna, ebizibu, n'okulemererwa abangi kwe beemulugunya, ne ku luyimba olw'ebigambo ebyangu ennyo n'omwana omuto by'asobola okutegeera, ekyama ky'obulamu obw'Ekikristaayo kye kiruwa? Awo ekirowoozo ne kinzijira: nsobola okusuubira nti nnaaweebwa okutwala oyo Mukama Yesu ow'ekitiibwa, ow'omu ggulu, owa Katonda, ne mulaga emmeeme zino zisobole okumulaba mu kitiibwa kye? Era nnaaweebwa okuzibula amaaso gaabwe balabe nti waliwo Kristo owa Katonda, Ayinzabyonna, ayingira ddala mu mutima era asuubiza n'obwesigwa nti: "Ndijja ne mbeera nammwe, era Ndi nammwe bulijjo"? Matayo 28:20. Nedda; ebigambo byange tebisobola kukola ekyo. Naye awo ne ndowooza nti: Mukama wange Yesu asobola okunkozesa ng'omuweereza owabulijjo okukwata abanafu ku mukono, okubagumya, n'okubayamba okugamba nti: Jjangu, jjangu, jjangu mu maaso ga Yesu omulindirire, era ajja kweyoleka gy'oli. Nsaba Katonda akozese Ekigambo kye eky'omuwendo. Kwe kubeerawo kwa Mukama Yesu kwokka. Ekyo kye kyama ky'amaanyi n'essanyu ly'Omukristaayo. Mumanyi nti bwe yali ku nsi, yabeeranga mu mubiri n'abayigirizwa be. Baatambulanga wamu olunaku lwonna, ekiro ne bagenda mu nnyumba y'emu, era oluusi baasulanga wamu ne balya ne banywa wamu. Baabeeranga wamu bulijjo. Okubeerawo kwa Yesu kwe kwali essomero ly'abayigirizwa be. Baali banyweredde mu Yye olw'omukwano ogwo ogw'ekitalo okumala emyaka esatu emiwanvu, era mu mukwano ogwo ne bayiga okumanya Kristo, ne Kristo n'abayigiriza n'abagolola, n'abategekera bye baali bagenda okufuna oluvannyuma. Kaakano ng'agenda, abagamba nti: "Era Ndi nammwe bulijjo n'okutuukira ddala ensi lw'eriggwaawo." Matayo 28:20. Nga kya kisuubizo! Era nga Kristo bwe yali ddala ne Peetero mu lyato, nga Kristo bwe yatuula ddala ne Yokaana ku mmeeza, bwe ntyo ddala bwe nsobola okuba ne Kristo nange. Era n'okusingawo, kubanga bo baalina Kristo waabwe mu mubiri, era gye bali yali muntu, omuntu eyeeyawudde ku bo; naye nze nsobola okuba ne Kristo agulumizibbwa mu maanyi g'entebe ey'obwakabaka eya Katonda, Kristo Ayinzabyonna, era Kristo abeera wonna. Nga kya kisuubizo! Mumbuuza nti: ekyo kisoboka kitya? N'eky'okuddamu kyange kye kino: kubanga Kristo ye Katonda, era kubanga Kristo, bwe yamala okufuuka omuntu, yalinnya ku ntebe ey'obwakabaka ne mu Bulamu bwa Katonda. Era kaakano oyo Kristo Yesu ow'omukisa, ow'omutima ogw'okwagala ogwafumitibwa; oyo Yesu Kristo ow'omukisa eyabeera ku nsi; Kristo oyo omu agulumizibbwa mu kitiibwa kya Katonda, asobola okubeera mu nze era asobola okubeera nange ennaku zonna. Mugamba nti: "Ddala kisoboka omusajja ali mu by'obusuubuzi, omukazi ali wakati mu maka amanene agalimu emirimu emingi, omwavu ajjudde okweraliikirira? Kisoboka? Nsobola okulowoozanga ku Yesu bulijjo?" Katonda yeebazibwe, teweetaaga kumulowoozangako bulijjo. Oyinza okuba omukulu wa bbanka, era okufaayo kwo kwonna kuyinza okwetaagibwa okutwala emirimu gy'olina okukola. Naye Katonda yeebazibwe: nze bwe mba nnina okulowooza ku mirimu gyange, Yesu anaalowooza ku nze, era anaayingira n'antwala mu buvunaanyizibwa bwe. Omwana oyo omuto ow'emyezi esatu, bw'aba yeebase mu mikono gya nnyina, agalamira awo nga talina buyambi; nnyina amumanyiiko katono, tamulowoozaako, naye nnyina alowooza ku mwana. Era kino kye kyama ekya mukisa eky'okwagala: nti Yesu, Katonda-Omuntu, alindirira okuyingira mu nze mu bukulu bw'okwagala kwe; era bw'atwala omutima gwange, ampambaatira mu mikono egyo egya Katonda n'aŋŋamba nti: "Mwana wange, Nze Omwesigwa, Nze Ow'amaanyi, nnaabeeranga naawe, nnaakulabiriranga ne nkukuumanga ennaku zonna." Aŋŋamba nti anaayingira mu mutima gwange ndyoke mbeere Omukristaayo omusanyufu, Omukristaayo omutukuvu, era Omukristaayo ow'omugaso. Mugamba nti: Woowe! Singa nnandisobodde okukkiriza ekyo, singa nnandirowoozezza nti kisoboka okuba ne Kristo bulijjo, buli ssaawa na buli kaseera nga ali nange, ng'antwala era ng'ankuuma mu buvunaanyizibwa bwe! Muganda wange, mwannyinaze, kye nkutegeeza kye kino kyennyini. Yesu bwe yagamba abayigirizwa be nti: "Ndi nammwe bulijjo," yakyogera mu bujjuvu bw'okubeera wonna okwa Katonda, mu bujjuvu bw'okwagala kwa Katonda, era ayaayaana okweyoleka gy'oli ekiro kino. Kaakano lowooza katono: ng'obwo bulamu bwa mukisa, okubeerawo kwa Yesu bwe kubeerera awo bulijjo! Ekyo si kye kyama ky'emirembe n'essanyu? Singa nnandituuse (buli mutima bwe gwogera bwe gutyo) ku mbeera eyo eya mukisa, buli lunaku era olunaku lwonna nga mpulira Yesu ng'andabirira era ng'ankuuma bulijjo, woowe, mirembe ki gye nnandibadde nagyo mu kirowoozo kino: "Sirina kye neeraliikirira Yye bw'anfaako, era sirina kye ntya Yye bw'ampa bye neetaaga." Omutima gwo gugamba nti kino kirungi nnyo okuba ekya mazima, era kya kitiibwa nnyo okuba ekikyo. Naye era okkiriza nti kiteekwa okuba ekya mukisa nnyo. Ggwe atya, ggwe akyamye, ggwe eyeeraliikirira: nkuleetedde ekisuubizo kya Katonda; kyange era kikyo. Yesu ajja kukikola; nga Katonda, asobola, era Yesu mwetegefu era ayaayaana, ng'Eyakomererwa, okukukuuma mu mirembe egituukiridde. Kino kya mazima eky'ekitalo, era kye kyama ky'essanyu eritayogerekeka. Era kino nakyo kye kyama ky'Obutukuvu. Mu kifo ky'ekibi ekibeera munda, Kristo abeera munda n'akiwangula; mu kifo ky'ekibi ekibeera munda, obulamu n'ekitangaala n'okwagala eby'Omwana wa Katonda ow'omukisa nga bibeera munda. Yye ye kyama ky'obutukuvu. "Kristo Yesu, eyafuuka amagezi gye tuli okuva eri Katonda, bwe butuukirivu, n'okutukuzibwa" 1 Abakkolinso 1:30. Mujjukire nti Kristo Yennyini ye yafuuka okutukuzibwa kwaffe. Kristo ng'ayingira mu nze, ng'atwala obuvunaanyizibwa bw'obulamu bwange bwonna: obuzaaliranwa bwange n'ebirowoozo byange n'okwagala kwange n'okusalawo kwange; ng'afuga byonna. Kino kye kinanfuula omutukuvu. Twogera ku butukuvu, naye mumanyi obutukuvu kye buli? Olina obutukuvu nga bw'olina Kristo, kubanga kyawandiikibwa nti: "Oyo atukuza era n'abo abatukuzibwa bava mu omu bonna" (Abaebbulaniya 2:11), era Kristo atukuza ng'aleeta obulamu bwa Katonda mu nze. Tusoma mu Balam 6:34 nti: "Omwoyo wa Mukama Katonda n'akka ku Gidyoni." Naye mumanyi nti mu Ndagaano Empya waliwo ekyawandiikibwa eky'ekitalo bwe kityo, we tusoma nti: "Twambale Mukama waffe Yesu Kristo" (Abaruumi 13:14), kwe kugamba: weyambaze Kristo Yesu. Ekyo kitegeeza ki? Tekitegeeza kubalirwa butuukirivu obuli ebweru wange kyokka, naye okwambala empisa ennamu eza Kristo omulamu, okwagala okulamu okwa Kristo omulamu. Yambala Mukama Yesu. Woowe! Mirimu ki? Sisobola kukikola okuggyako nga nkkiriza era nga ntegeera nti Oyo gwe nnina okwambala ali ng'ekyambalo ekibikka obulamu bwange bwonna. Nnina okwambala Kristo omulamu eyagamba nti: "Ndi nammwe bulijjo." Matayo 28:20. Weesibeko busibi amakanzu g'ekyambalo ekyo eky'ekitangaala Kristo ky'ayagala okukwambaza. Jjangu bujji okkirize nti Kristo ali naawe, ali ku ggwe, era ali mu ggwe. Woowe, mwambale! Era bw'otunuulira empisa ze emu ku emu; n'owulira ekigambo kya Katonda nti: "Mubengamu endowooza eri eyali mu Kristo Yesu" (Abafiripi 2:5), ne kikutegeeza nti yagondera n'okutuusa ku kufa; awo n'oddamu nti: Kristo omugonvu, Kristo eyalina obulamu bwonna nga bwa kugondera, oyo ye Kristo gwe nnafuna era gwe nnambala. Afuuka obulamu bwange, n'obugonvu bwe bubeera ku nze okutuusa lwe njiga okwogera mpolampola nga Yesu bwe yakola nti: "Kitange, by'oyagala bye binaakolebwa; ekyanzigya mu ggulu kwe kukola ekyo Katonda eyantuma ky'ayagala, so si Nze bye njagala ku bwange." Yokaana 6:38. Kino nakyo kye kyama ky'amaanyi mu bujulizi ne mu mulimu. Kiki ekizibuwalira okugondera, era lwaki nnyonoona emirundi mingi bwe gityo? Abantu bayimba nti: "Woowe, okuba owuwo ddala," era bakiyimba okuva ku mutima. Kiki ekibafuula abajeemu nate? Obujeemu buva wa? Era eky'okuddamu kye kino. Kubanga ngezaako okugondera Kristo ali ewala, n'olwekyo ebiragiro bye tebijja na maanyi. Mulabe kye nsanga mu Kigambo kya Katonda. Katonda bwe yayagalanga okutuma omuntu yenna mu mulimu gwe, yasookanga okumusisinkana n'okwogera naye, n'amugumyanga omulundi n'omulundi. Katonda yalabikira Ibulayimu emirundi musanvu oba munaana n'amuwa ekiragiro kimu oluvannyuma lw'ekirala, bw'atyo Ibulayimu n'ayiga okumugondera ddala. Katonda yalabikira Yoswa ne Gidyoni, nabo ne bagondera. Naye lwaki ffe tetugondera? Kubanga tulina katono nnyo ak'omukwano guno ogw'okumpi ne Yesu. Singa twamanya ekyama kino ekya mukisa, eky'omu ggulu, eky'okuba n'okubeerawo kwa Kristo naffe buli lunaku, buli ssaawa, buli ddakiika, nga kyandibadde ssanyu okugondera! Tetwandisobodde kutambula mu kutegeera kuno: "Mukama wange Yesu ali nange era anneetoolodde," ne tutamugondera! Woowe, totandika kwegomba n'okugamba nti: kino kye nteekwa okuba nakyo, okubeerawo kwa Yesu okubeerera awo bulijjo! Waliwo Abakristaayo abamu abagezaako obutaba bajeemu, abajja eri emirimu gyabwe egya Ssande n'egya wakati mu wiiki n'obwesigwa bungi, ne basaba ekisa n'omukisa, era beemulugunya olw'omukisa omutono ennyo n'amaanyi amatono, amaanyi matono nnyo! Lwaki? Kubanga temuli Yesu mulamu amala mu mitima gyabwe. Oluusi ndowooza ku kino ng'amazima agasinga obuzito. Waliwo enjawulo nnene ey'ebirabo mu basumba ne mu balala aboogera, naye nkakasa kino: nti ebirabo by'omuntu si kye kipimo ky'amaanyi ge amazima. Nkakasa kino: nti Katonda asobola okulaba ekyo ggwe nange kye tutasobola kulaba. Oluusi abantu bawulirako katono, naye ng'omuntu bw'aba nakyo mu mazima — si ng'enneewulira, oba okwegomba, oba ekirowoozo, naye mu mazima — omwoyo gwennyini n'okubeerawo kwa Yesu nga biri ku ye, muva amaanyi agatalabika, agasirise. Amaanyi ago ag'ekyama kwe kubeerawo Okutukuvu okwa Yesu. "Ndi nammwe bulijjo." Matayo 28:20. Kaakano, oba bye njogedde bimaze okulaga nga bwe kiri ekintu ekyegombebwa, nga bwe kiri ekya mukisa okukibeererawo, kale kaakano ka mbawe eky'okuddamu ky'ekibuuzo ekizuukira mu mitima egisukka mu gumu. Mpulira omuntu ng'agamba nti: "Mbuulira engeri gye nnyinza okufuna okubeerawo kuno okwa mukisa okwa Yesu okubeerera awo; era bwe nnaamala okukufuna, engeri gye nnyinza okukukuuma. Ndowooza bwe mba na kino, mba na byonna. Mukama Yesu ansemberedde nnyo. Ngezezzaako okuva ku buli kintu ekiyinza okunziyiza, era mbadde ne Mukama wange kumpi nnyo. Naye nnaamanya ntya nti anaabeeranga nange bulijjo?" Singa wabuuzizza Mukama nti: "Ayi Mukama wange Kristo ow'omukisa, nkole ki? Nnyinza ntya okusanyukira okubeerawo kwo okutaggwaawo?" eky'okuddamu kye ekisooka kyandibadde nti: "Kkiriza kyokka. Nkyogedde emirundi mingi, n'okitegeera kitundu butundu, naye nnaakyogera nate: Mwana wange, kkiriza kyokka." Kuba kwa kukkiriza. Oluusi twogera ku kukkiriza ng'obwesige, era kya mugaso nnyo okugamba abantu nti okukkiriza bwe bwesige; naye abantu bwe bagamba, nga bwe bagamba oluusi, nti si kirala wabula bwesige bwokka, ekyo si kituufu. Kigambo kigazi nnyo okusinga obwesige. Kuba kwa kukkiriza kwe njigira okumanya Oyo atalabika, Katonda atalabika, ne mulaba. Okukkiriza ge maaso gange ag'omwoyo ku ebyo ebitalabika n'eby'omu ggulu. Emirundi mingi ofuba nnyo okwesiga Katonda, n'olemererwa. Lwaki? Kubanga tosoose kutwala kiseera kulaba Katonda. Osobola otya okwesiga Katonda ddala nga tonnamusisinkana n'okumumanya? Obuuza nti: "Ntandikira wa?" Osaana otandike ng'okkiriza okusooka, ng'weeyanjula mu maaso ga Katonda ono mu mbeera y'okusinza okusirise, n'omusaba akkirize okuwulira okw'obukulu bwe n'okubeerawo kwe kukujjire. Oteekwa okumusaba omutima gwo gubikkibwe n'okubeerawo kwe okutukuvu. Oteekwa okunoonya okufuula okubeerawo kwa Katonda Ayinzabyonna era ajjudde okwagala okuba okwa mazima mu mutima gwo, Katonda ow'okwagala okutayogerekeka. Twala ekiseera okumusinza nga Katonda ayinzabyonna, okuwulira nti amaanyi gennyini agaatonda ensi, amaanyi gennyini agaazuukiza Yesu mu bafu, mu kaseera kano gakolera mu mutima gwo. Tetukifunako bukakafu kubanga tetukikkiriza. Tuteekwa okutwala ekiseera okukkiriza. Yesu agamba nti: "Woowe mwana wange, ziba amaaso go eri ensi, oggye mu mutima gwo ebirowoozo bino byonna ebikwata ku ddiini, otandike okukkiriza Katonda Yennyini." Eyo y'ennyingo esooka ey'Okukkiriza: "Nzikiriza Katonda." Nga nkkiriza, nziggulawo omutima gwange okusembeza Katonda ono ow'ekitiibwa, ne nkutama ne nsinza.
