Era nga nkikkiriza kino, ntunula waggulu ne ndaba Omwana gw'Endiga ku Ntebe ey'Obwakabaka, ne nkkiriza nti amaanyi ga Katonda Ayinzabyonna gali mu Yesu lwa nsonga eyo yennyini: okubikkulira omutima gwange okubeerawo kwe. Lwaki waliwo babiri ku Ntebe ey'Obwakabaka? Katonda tamala? Omwana gw'Endiga owa Katonda ali ku Ntebe ey'Obwakabaka ku lulwo era ku lwange; Omwana gw'Endiga ali ku Ntebe ey'Obwakabaka ye Kristo Yennyini, ng'alina amaanyi nga Katonda okuntwala. Woowe, tolowooza nti tosobola kufuna kutegeera okwo. Era tokulowooza ng'okuli kumpi naawe kaakano kwokka, naye kuza empisa ey'okukkiriza. "Yesu, nzikiriza ekitiibwa kyo; nzikiriza okuyinzabyonna kwo; nzikiriza amaanyi go agakolera munda yange. Nzikiriza okubeerawo kwo okulamu, okw'okwagala, nga kuli nange, nga kweyoleka mu maanyi ga Katonda." Teweeraliikiriranga nneewulira wadde ebyokulabirako. Ojja kukiraba nga kyangu nnyo era nga kwewulira bwesige bwereere n'okugamba nti: "Nkakasa nti Yye wange ddala mu byonna." Weerabire wekka okumala akaseera; teweerowoozangako wadde okweyogerako, naye lowooza ku ekyo Yesu ky'ali. N'oluvannyuma jjukira: bulijjo kkiriza. Oluusi mpulira nga sisobola kufuna bigambo bya kutegeeza Katonda nga bw'ayagala abantu be okukkiriza okuva enkya okutuusa ekiro. Buli mukka gwe tussa gwandibadde bukkirizi bwereere. Weewaawo, kya mazima ddala; Mukama Yesu ayagala tubeerenga mu kukkiriza kwokka okuva enkya okutuusa akawungeezi, era oteekwa okutandika okufuula ekyo ekintu ekikulu mu bulamu. Bw'ozuukuka enkya, omutima gwo gufulume n'okukkiriza okunene mu kino, ne mu makesa g'ekiro ekirowoozo kino kibeere naawe: Omulokozi wange Yesu anneetoolodde era ali kumpi nange; era osobola okutunula waggulu n'ogamba nti: "Njagala kukwesiganga bulijjo." Omanyi obwesige kye buli. Kiwoomerera nnyo okwesiga. Era tosobola kaakano kwesiga Yesu, okubeerawo kuno, okubeerawo kuno okukuuma? Abeera mulamu ku lulwo mu Ggulu. Oteekeddwako akabonero k'omusaayi gwe, era akwagala; era tosobola kugamba nti: "Kabaka wange, Kabaka wange, Yye ali nange ennaku zonna"? Woowe, weesige Yesu okutuukiriza ebisuubizo bye yennyini. Waliwo eky'okuddamu ekyokubiri ndowooza Kristo kye yandiwadde singa tujja gy'ali nga tukkiriza ne tugamba nti: "Waliwo ekirala, Mukama wange ow'omukisa?" Ndowooza mpulira eky'okuddamu kye: "Mwana wange, gonderanga bulijjo." Tolema kutegeera kisomesebwa ekiri mu kigambo kino ekimu. Oteekwa okutwala ddala ekigambo ekyo GONDERA, n'obugonvu, n'oyiga okwogera ku bwo wekka nti: "Kaakano nnina okugondera, era olw'ekisa kya Katonda nnaagondera mu buli kintu." Ku mwoleso gwaffe oguwedde e Cape, Omwami Rhodes, Katikkiro waffe, yagenda ku mulyango ng'alowooza nti yalina ensimbi z'okuyingira mu nsawo ye. Naye bwe yatuuka ku mulyango, yasanga nga talina nsimbi zimala, n'agamba omukuumi w'omulyango nti: "Nze Mwami Rhodes; nzikiriza nnyingire, era nnaalaba nga tofiirwa." Naye omusajja n'agamba nti: "Sisobola kukiyamba, ssebo; nnina ebiragiro byange," n'agaana Omwami Rhodes okuyingira. Kyamugwanira okwewola ku mukwano gwe n'asasula n'alyoka ayita mu mulyango. Oluvannyuma ku kyekiro, Omwami Rhodes yakyogerako n'agamba nti kyali ssanyu lya mazima okulaba omuntu ng'anywerera ku kiragiro kye bw'atyo. Bwe kityo bwe kiri. Omusajja yalina ebiragiro bye, era ekyo kyamumala, era buli eyajjanga ku mulyango yalina okusasula ensimbi ze ez'okuyingira n'alyoka ayingira. Abaana ba Katonda basaana okuba ng'abaserikale, nga beetegefu okugamba nti: "Nteekwa okugondera." Woowe! Okuba n'ekirowoozo ekyo mu mitima gyaffe: "Yesu, njagala okukugondera." Wateekwa okubaawo omukwano ogw'obuntu n'Omulokozi, n'oluvannyuma ne lujja essanyu ly'okuweereza okw'obuntu n'obwesigwa. Oli mwetegefu okugondera mu bunafu bwonna n'obuyinike n'okutya? Osobola okugamba nti: "Weewaawo, Mukama Yesu, nnaagondera"? Bwe kiba bwe kityo, weewengayo ddala. Awo enneewulira yo eneebeera nti: "Sijja kwogera kigambo na kimu bwe mba ndowooza nti Yesu tandyagadde kukiwulira. Sijja kubeera na ndowooza yange ku bwange, naye obulamu bwange bwonna bunaabikkibwa n'obulongoofu bw'obugonvu bwe eri Kitaffe n'okwagala kwe okwewaayo ku lwange. Njagala Kristo abeere n'obulamu bwange bwonna, omutima gwange gwonna, empisa zange zonna. Njagala okufaanana Kristo n'okugondera." Weewengayo eri obugonvu buno obw'okwagala. Ekirowoozo ekyokusatu kye kino: bwe ŋŋamba nti: "Mukama wange, Omulokozi ow'omukisa, mbuulira byonna: nnaakkiriza, ngondera, era nnaagondera. Waliwo ekirala kye nneetaaga okwekakasiza essanyu ly'okubeerawo kwo okubeerera awo?" ne mpulira eky'okuddamu kino: "Mwana wange, omukwano ogw'okumpi nange buli lunaku." Aa, awo we wali ensobi y'abangi abagezaako okugondera ne bagezaako okukkiriza; bakikola mu maanyi gaabwe, era tebamanyi nti Mukama Yesu bw'aba anaafuga mu mitima gyabwe, bateekwa okuba n'okussekimu okw'okumpi naye buli lunaku. Tosobola kukola byonna by'ayagala, naye Yesu ajja kubikukolera. Waliwo Abakristaayo bangi abalemererwa wano, era olw'ensonga eyo tebategeera kye kiri okuba n'okussekimu ne Yesu. Ka ngezeeko okubakakasa kino: Katonda abawadde Omulokozi ow'okwagala, omulamu; era anaakuwa atya omukisa nga tomusisinkana? Essanyu ly'omukwano lisangibwa mu kussekimu; era Yesu asaba kino buli lunaku, alyoke afune ekiseera eky'okunkwatako, eky'okumbuulira ebibye yennyini, eky'okunjigiriza, eky'okunfuuwamu Omwoyo we, eky'okumpa obulamu obupya n'essanyu n'amaanyi. Era mujjukire: okussekimu ne Yesu tekitegeeza kitundu kya ssaawa, oba essaawa emu mu kasenge ko. Omuntu ayinza okusoma Bayibuli ye oba ekitabo kye eky'ennyinnyonnyola n'obwegendereza; ayinza okunoonya ennyiriri zonna ezikwatagana mu ssuula; bw'afuluma mu kasenge ke ayinza okukubuulira byonna ebikikwatako, naye ng'asisinkanye Yesu enkya eyo n'akatono. Osabye eddakiika ttaano oba kkumi, naye tosisinkanye Yesu. Bwe tutyo tuteekwa okujjukira nti newaakubadde Bayibuli ya muwendo nnyo nnyini, n'okugisoma kya mukisa nnyo era kyetaagisa, okusaba n'okusoma Bayibuli si kwe kussekimu ne Yesu. Kye twetaaga buli nkya kwe kusisinkana Yesu n'okugamba nti: "Mukama, olunaku luzze nate, era ndi munafu mu nze nzekka nga bwe nabanga bulijjo; jjangu ondiise ku ggwe wennyini enkya eno, oyogere n'emmeeme yange." Woowe mikwano gyange, si kukkiriza kwammwe kunaabayimirizaawo, naye Yesu omulamu, gwe musisinkana buli lunaku mu kussekimu, mu kusinza ne mu kwagala. Lindirira mu maaso ge, ne bw'owulira ng'oli wa mpewo era nga tolina kukkiriza. Lindirira mu maaso ge ogambe nti: "Mukama, nga bwe siriiko kye nsobola, nzikiriza era mpummulira mu bukakafu obwa mukisa nti ky'osuubizza ojja kukinkolera." Mbuuza Mukama wange omulundi omulala nti: "Mukama Yesu, ebyo bye byonna?" N'eky'okuddamu kye kiri nti: "Nedda, mwana wange; nnina ekintu kimu ekirala." "Era kye kiruwa? Oŋŋambye okukkiriza, n'okugondera, n'okubeera kumpi naawe: kiki ekirala ky'oyagala?" "Nkolera, mwana wange. Jjukira, nakununula lwa kuweereza Kwange; nakununula obeere omujulirwa afuluma mu nsi ng'onjatula mu maaso g'abantu." Woowe, tokweka kyobugagga kyo, so tolowooza nti Yesu bw'aba naawe osobola okukikweka. Ekintu kimu ku bibiri kijja kubaawo: oba oteekwa okuleka byonna, oba kiteekwa okufuluma. Oboolyawo wawulira ku muwala omuto eyasangibwa, oluvannyuma lw'olumu ku nkuŋŋaana za Mwami Moody, ng'ayimba ezimu ku nnyimba ffenna ze tumanyi. Abazadde b'omwana baali balina ekifo ekirungi mu bantu, era bwe yali ng'ayimba ennyimba ezo mu ddiiro, nnyina n'amugaana. Olunaku lumu yali ng'ayimba oluyimba "Woowe, nsanyuka nnyo Yesu okunjagala," nnyina n'agamba nti: "Mwana wange, kiki ekikuyimbisa luno so nga nnakugaana?" N'addamu nti: "Woowe maama, sisobola kukyewala; kifuluma kyokka." Yesu Kristo bw'aba mu mutima, ateekwa okufuluma. Mujjukire: si buvunaanyizibwa bwaffe bwokka okumwatula; kiri bwe kityo, naye kiriko n'ekisingawo. Bw'otokikola, kaba kabonero kokka nti teweewaddeyo eri Yesu: empisa zo, erinnya lyo, ne byonna by'olina. Omumma ekintu. Oteekwa okwatula Yesu mu nsi, mu maka go, ne buli wantu. Omanyi ekiragiro kya Mukama nti: "Mugende mu nsi zonna mubuulire Enjiri eri ebitonde byonna." "Era laba, Ndi nammwe," ekitegeeza nti: "Omuntu yenna ayinza okunkolera, era nnaabeeranga naye." Kya mazima eri omusumba, eri omuminsani, n'eri buli mukkiriza akolera Yesu. Okubeerawo kwa Yesu kukwatagana nnyo n'omulimu ogumukolerwa. Ogamba nti: "Sikirowoozangako. Nnina omulimu gwange ogwa Ssande, naye mu wiiki sikola mulimu ku lulwe." Tosobola kuba na kubeerawo kwa Yesu n'oleka kino okweyongera okuba bwe kityo. Sikkiriza nti wandisobodde okuba n'okubeerawo kwa Yesu wiiki yonna naye n'otamukolerako kintu na kimu; noolwekyo, amagezi gange ge gano: kolera Oyo asaanira; omukisa gwe n'okubeerawo kwe binaasangibwa mu mulimu. Kya mukisa okukolera Kristo mu nsi eno ezikirira. Woowe, lwaki emitima gyaffe emirundi mingi giwulira nga mpewo era nga migale, n'abangi ku ffe ne tugamba nti: "Simpulira nga nyitiddwa mu mulimu gwa Kristo"? Beera mwetegefu okwewaayo eri okuweereza kwa Mukama, era ajja kweyoleka gy'oli. Kristo ajja n'ekisuubizo kye eky'ekitalo, era ky'agamba, akigamba abakkiriza bonna: "Ndi nammwe bulijjo; ekyo kye kisuubizo Kyange; kino Nze mu maanyi Gange kye nsobola okukola; kino kye nneesiba n'obwesigwa okutuukiriza; onookikkiriza? Neewaayo gy'oli, ggwe emmeeme." Eri buli omu ku abo abazze gy'ali, Kristo agamba nti: "Neewaayo gy'oli, okuba owuwo ddala era owuwo yenna buli ssaawa eya buli lunaku; okubeera naawe era mu ggwe buli kaseera, okukuwa omukisa n'okukuwanirira, n'okukuwa buli kaseera okutegeera okubeerawo Kwange; nnaabeera owuwo ddala, ddala, ddala." Kaakano, oludda olulala lwe luluwa? Ayagala nze mbeere Owuwe ddala. Oli mwetegefu okutwala kino ng'ekigambo kyo eky'omusingi kaakano: "Wa Katonda ddala"? Ayi Katonda, fuuwa okubeerawo kwo mu mutima gwange olyoke oyakire okuva mu bulamu bwange. "Wa Katonda ddala": kino kibeere ekigambo kyaffe eky'omusingi. Mujje twevuunike wansi mu maaso g'ebigere bye. Omuminsani waffe ow'e Nyasalandi agamba nti emirundi mingi akwatibwako okulaba engeri Abakristaayo ab'omu kitundu, bwe baleetebwa eri Yesu, gye batayimirira mu kusaba; tebafukamira, naye beesuula wansi ku ttaka n'ebyenyi byabwe okutuuka ku ttaka, ne bagalamira awo, ne bakaabirira Katonda mu maloboozi ag'omwanguka. Oluusi mpulira nga nandyagadde ffe ffennyini tusobole okukola ekyo, naye tetukyetaaga. Ka tukikole mu mwoyo, kubanga Omwana wa Katonda ow'emirembe n'emirembe azze mu mitima gyaffe. Onoomutwala n'omukuuma omwo, okumuwa ekitiibwa n'okumuleka akole nga bw'ayagala? Jjangu kaakano ogambe nti: "Nnaakunoonya n'omutima gwange gwonna; ndi wuwo ddala." Weeweyo gy'ali ddala akutwalire ddala. Ajja kukutwala era akuume okukutwala okwo. Jjangu kaakano. Yesu asanyukira okusinza kw'Abatukuvu be. Obulamu bwaffe bwonna busobola okufuuka ekikolwa kimu ekitasalako eky'okusinza n'omulimu ogw'okwagala n'essanyu, bwe tunajjukiranga ne tussa ekitiibwa mu kino: nti Yesu yagamba nti: "Ndi nammwe bulijjo n'okutuukira ddala ensi lw'eriggwaawo." Matayo 28:20.
